name: Shoulder circles
instruction: Stand tall with the arms relaxed. Make slow circles with the shoulders backward. Then make slow circles forward. Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
phases: Front three-quarter view. Stand tall with the shoulders low and the arms hanging loosely.
Both shoulders roll slightly forward and rise toward the ears; elbows remain heavy.
Both shoulders draw back and start to descend, opening the chest slightly. Keep the head and feet in place.

name: Small arm circles
instruction: Stand tall and raise the arms to shoulder height. Make small circles forward. Then make small circles backward. Keep the circles tight and controlled.
phases: Oblique view. Extend both arms sideways at shoulder height with the fingertips just forward of the shoulder line.
Trace the upper part of the small circle with both hands slightly above shoulder level. Keep elbows long.
Hands pass just behind the shoulder line and lower slightly on the rear of the same small circle. The arms stay outstretched throughout.

name: Standing twists
instruction: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Keep the hips mostly facing forward. Rotate the upper body to one side. Return to center and rotate to the other side.
phases: Feet hip-width, pelvis facing ahead, upper torso turned gently to the left.
Stand centered with sternum and pelvis facing ahead.
Rotate the chest gently to the right over the same planted feet.

name: Hip hinge
instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Soften the knees slightly. Push the hips back. Lower the torso with a straight back. Return to standing by driving the hips forward.
phases: Stand upright with hip-width feet flat, knees slightly soft and arms relaxed.
Hips move backward, torso tips forward as one long line and arms hang freely below shoulders. Keep shins nearly upright.

name: Shallow squat
instruction: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width. Push the hips slightly back. Bend the knees only to a comfortable depth. Return to standing slowly.
phases: Stand upright, whole feet planted slightly wider than the hips, hands comfortably in front.
Sit the hips back into a shallow squat, knees tracking the toes and heels planted. Keep the torso long.

name: High plank weight shift
instruction: Start in a high plank position. Hands are under the shoulders. Shift the body slightly forward. Shift back to the starting position. Keep the movement small and controlled.
phases: High plank, palms below shoulders, elbows extended and body straight from head to heels.
Keeping hands planted and body rigid, shift forward slightly on the toes so shoulders just pass wrists.

name: Standing breathing + reach
instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Inhale and reach both arms overhead. Lengthen gently through the spine. Exhale and lower the arms, dropping the shoulders.
phases: Stand over hip-width feet, arms down, shoulders relaxed.
Reach both arms overhead on the inhale, ribs stacked over pelvis, heels down.

name: Standing torso rotations
instruction: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Let the arms swing loosely. Rotate the upper body to one side. Flow smoothly to the other side.
phases: Stand facing forward from the hips, with shoulders turned left and relaxed arms following.
Pass through the middle facing forward, arms hanging loosely.
Rotate the shoulders right with the arms following the trunk, keeping both feet planted.

name: Arm swings
instruction: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart. Swing the arms forward and backward in a controlled way. Let the chest open naturally as the arms move back. Keep the movement smooth and relaxed.
phases: Stand tall with arms swinging forward together, elbows soft, feet planted.
Same stance, arms swept a little behind the body, chest open, controlled range.

name: Forearm plank
instruction: Place the elbows under the shoulders. Step the feet back. Make a straight line from shoulders to heels. Tighten the abs and glutes. Hold the position.
phases: Show the held forearm plank from the side: elbows under shoulders, forearms flat, toes planted, straight shoulder–hip–heel line, gaze toward the floor.

name: RKC plank
instruction: Start in a forearm plank. Tighten the abs strongly. Squeeze the glutes. Imagine pulling the elbows toward the toes. Hold with maximum control.
phases: Hold a forearm plank, elbows directly beneath shoulders, toes tucked, fists lightly closed, glutes and abdomen braced; head, hips and heels aligned.

name: Scissors
instruction: Lie on the back. Press the lower back gently toward the floor. Lift the legs. Cross one leg over the other. Continue alternating the crossing motion.
phases: Supine, lower back in contact with mat. Both long legs hover, with left ankle crossing above right in the horizontal scissor.
Right ankle now crosses above left as the legs slide past each other sideways. Keep the legs hovering.

name: Flutter kicks
instruction: Lie on the back. Press the lower back toward the floor. Lift the legs. Move the legs up and down in short alternating kicks.
phases: Side-oblique view, supine, lower back supported. Right straight leg a little higher than left, both hovering.
Left leg a little higher and right lower: a small up-and-down flutter from the hips.

name: Reverse crunch
instruction: Lie on the back. Bend the knees and lift the feet. Use the abs to curl the pelvis slightly upward. Lower back down slowly.
phases: Supine with hips on mat, knees bent over hips, shins roughly parallel to floor and arms alongside.
Knees move toward chest as pelvis rolls a short distance off mat; upper back remains in contact.

name: Hollow hold (easy)
instruction: Lie on the back. Press the lower back toward the floor. Lift the shoulders slightly. Keep the knees bent or legs raised higher. Hold the position.
phases: Supine hollow hold with bent knees drawn up, shoulder blades just off the floor, arms reaching toward thighs, lower back pressed to mat.

name: Side plank
instruction: Lie on one side. Place the elbow under the shoulder. Lift the hips. Keep the body in one straight line. Hold the position.
phases: Hold a side forearm plank with elbow beneath shoulder, legs long, hips lifted in line with the ankles and shoulders.

name: Side plank hip lift
instruction: Start in a side plank. Lower the hips slightly. Lift the hips back up. Repeat with control. Switch sides.
phases: Side forearm support with legs extended, upper hand on hip; allow the hips to dip slightly toward the mat.
Lift hips back to a straight shoulder-to-ankle line, same supporting elbow and feet.

name: Plank shoulder taps
instruction: Start in a high plank. Keep the hips level and stable. Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder. Return it and tap with the other hand. Keep the body still.
phases: High plank, both hands under shoulders, feet slightly wide, hips level.
Right hand rests briefly on left shoulder, supported by left palm and both feet.
Left hand rests on right shoulder, supported by right palm and both feet. Body stays square.

name: Up-down plank
instruction: Start in a forearm plank. Place one hand on the floor and press up. Bring the other hand up into a high plank. Lower back down to the forearms. Alternate the leading arm.
phases: Start in a low plank with both forearms supporting, elbows below shoulders, feet planted.
One palm replaces its elbow beneath the shoulder while the other forearm stays on the mat.
Press up into a high plank on both palms, arms extended and hips level.

name: Heel taps
instruction: Lie on the back. Lift the legs into a tabletop position. Lower one heel toward the floor. Tap lightly and return. Alternate sides.
phases: Supine with hips and knees at right angles, both shins level and arms resting on floor.
Lower one bent leg until its heel just touches the floor; the opposite leg remains in tabletop.
Show the other heel touching, opposite leg back in tabletop and lower back supported.

name: Dead bug (advanced)
instruction: Lie on the back. Lift the arms and legs into tabletop position. Extend the opposite arm and leg. Keep the lower back stable. Return and switch sides.
phases: Supine, arms pointing up, both knees bent over hips, shins level.
Reach right arm overhead while left leg extends low off the mat; left arm stays up and right knee bent.
Extend left arm and right leg instead; keep the inactive arm upright and the inactive knee bent.

name: Bicycle crunches
instruction: Lie on the back. Bring the knees up. Place the hands lightly near the head. Rotate the torso and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee. Switch sides in a controlled rhythm.
phases: Supine, hands lightly by temples, shoulders lifted. Rotate right elbow toward left bent knee as right leg extends.
Rotate left elbow toward right bent knee as left leg extends, pelvis steady.

name: Push-ups
instruction: Start in a high plank. Place the hands under the shoulders or slightly wider. Lower the body with control. Push back up while keeping the body straight.
phases: High plank, hands slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight, toes supporting.
Lower the whole body until chest nears the mat, elbows angling back and head-to-heel line intact.

name: Narrow push-ups
instruction: Start in a high plank. Place the hands closer than in a regular push-up. Keep the elbows near the body. Lower slowly and press back up.
phases: High plank with hands narrower than shoulder width and elbows extended.
Chest lowered between hands, elbows held close to sides, hips aligned with body.

name: Paused push-ups
instruction: Start in a regular push-up position. Lower slowly. Pause for one second near the bottom. Push back up without losing body position.
phases: High plank, hands slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight, toes supporting.
Lower the whole body until chest nears the mat, elbows angling back and head-to-heel line intact.

name: Slow push-ups 3-1-3
instruction: Start in a high plank. Lower for about three seconds. Pause for one second near the bottom. Push up for about three seconds.
phases: High plank, hands slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight, toes supporting.
Lower the whole body until chest nears the mat, elbows angling back and head-to-heel line intact.

name: Staggered push-ups
instruction: Start in a push-up position. Place one hand slightly forward and the other slightly back. Lower with control. Push back up. Switch hand position on the next side.
phases: High plank, one hand a little forward of its shoulder and the other a little behind, both feet anchored.
Bend both elbows, lowering the straight body while preserving the staggered hand placement.

name: Pike push-ups
instruction: Start in a high plank. Walk the feet slightly closer and lift the hips. Keep the head between the arms. Lower the head toward the floor. Press back up.
phases: Hands and feet on the floor, hips high in an inverted V, arms straight and head between upper arms.
Bend elbows and lower the head toward a point just ahead of the hands, keeping the hips high and feet planted.

name: Sphinx push-ups
instruction: Start on the forearms with the body long. Keep the elbows under or slightly ahead of the shoulders. Press through the hands and forearms. Extend the elbows slightly. Return with control.
phases: Long forearm plank, both palms flat, elbows under or just ahead of shoulders.
Press through the unmoved palms and raise both elbows a little clear of the floor, keeping the trunk long.

name: Cobra hold
instruction: Lie face down. Place the arms along the body. Turn the thumbs slightly outward. Lift the chest slightly. Pull the shoulder blades back and down. Hold.
phases: Lie face down, arms alongside torso, thumbs facing out. Hold chest a little clear of mat, shoulder blades drawn back and down, neck long.

name: Reverse snow angels
instruction: Lie on the stomach. Keep the head facing down. Move the arms in a wide arc from the sides toward overhead. Return along the same path. Keep the movement controlled.
phases: Prone, head facing mat, long arms close to outer thighs.
Sweep both long arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Reach both arms diagonally overhead in the same plane, without lifting the chin.

name: Prone W-raise
instruction: Lie face down. Bend the elbows into a W shape. Lift the elbows and hands slightly. Squeeze the shoulder blades. Lower with control.
phases: Face down, gaze toward mat, elbows bent in a W with hands and elbows resting.
Lift elbows and hands together a few centimetres, keeping the W and the neck long.

name: Prone Y-raise
instruction: Lie face down. Reach the arms diagonally overhead into a Y shape. Lift the arms slightly from the floor. Lower with control.
phases: Prone, arms diagonally overhead in a Y, thumbs facing up and head low.
Raise both arms slightly above the mat without lifting the chin; retain the Y shape.

name: Prone T-raise
instruction: Lie face down. Extend the arms out to the sides in a T shape. Lift the arms slightly. Squeeze the shoulder blades. Lower slowly.
phases: Lie face down with both straight arms resting out to the sides in a T.
Maintain the T, squeezing shoulder blades and lifting both arms slightly.

name: Superman pull-down
instruction: Lie on the stomach with arms overhead. Lift the chest slightly. Pull the elbows down toward the ribs. Squeeze the shoulder blades. Reach the arms forward again.
phases: Lie prone, chest slightly lifted, gaze toward mat, both arms reaching overhead.
Draw elbows toward ribs with forearms forward and shoulder blades together, keeping torso low.

name: Swimmers
instruction: Lie on the stomach. Lift the chest slightly. Move opposite arm and leg in a controlled swimming pattern. Keep the movement small and steady.
phases: Prone, face down, right arm and left leg hovering above the other pair.
Swap to left arm and right leg lifted, keeping the other pair low and neck long.

name: Reverse plank
instruction: Sit on the floor with legs extended. Place the hands behind the hips. Press through the hands and heels. Lift the hips. Hold the body in a long line.
phases: Hold a reverse plank, palms planted behind shoulders, arms straight, heels on floor, hips lifted into a long line with shoulders and ankles.

name: Back extension pulses
instruction: Lie face down. Place the hands beside the body or lightly near the chest. Lift the chest slightly. Make small controlled pulses. Keep the neck neutral.
phases: Prone, arms alongside body, head and upper chest just clear of mat.
Lift the chest a few centimetres higher in a small pulse without tipping the head back.

name: Cobra to W-pull
instruction: Lie face down with arms forward. Lift the chest slightly. Pull the elbows down and back into a W shape. Squeeze the shoulder blades. Reach forward again and lower with control.
phases: Prone with both arms reached forward and chest close to mat.
Chest slightly elevated, elbows bent and drawn back into a W, forearms off mat, gaze down.

name: Swimmers
instruction: Lie face down, arms reaching overhead. Lift the chest and legs slightly. Raise one arm and the opposite leg. Lower and switch sides, alternating smoothly.
phases: Prone, face down, right arm and left leg hovering above the other pair.
Swap to left arm and right leg lifted, keeping the other pair low and neck long.

name: Self-resist curl
instruction: Stand or sit tall. Bend one elbow like a curl. Use the opposite hand to press down on the working forearm. Curl upward slowly against resistance. Switch sides.
phases: Upright with working elbow at side, forearm low and palm facing up; opposite palm contacts the working forearm.
Curl the working forearm upward against the other hand, elbow anchored and shoulders level.

name: Biceps isometric 90°
instruction: Bend one elbow to about 90 degrees. Use the opposite hand to press down. The working arm resists without moving. Hold the tension. Switch sides.
phases: Upright with one elbow at the side bent 90 degrees, palm up. Press opposite palm downward on working forearm while the working arm holds still.

name: Palm-hook pull
instruction: Hook the fingers or hands together. Keep the elbows slightly bent. Pull the hands away from each other. Hold steady tension. Relax slowly.
phases: Stand with hands hooked together in front of the chest, bent elbows out to the sides; maintain the outward pull without separating the hands.

name: Slow negative curl
instruction: Start with one elbow bent. Use the opposite hand to create resistance. Slowly lower the working forearm. Keep resisting during the lowering phase. Switch sides.
phases: Working elbow fixed to the side and bent, forearm raised, opposite palm pressing on the working forearm.
Lower the working forearm to a more open elbow angle against the same contact, wrist straight.

name: Shallow squat
instruction: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width. Push the hips back. Bend the knees to a comfortable shallow depth. Stand back up slowly.
phases: Stand upright, whole feet planted slightly wider than the hips, hands comfortably in front.
Sit the hips back into a shallow squat, knees tracking the toes and heels planted. Keep the torso long.

name: Paused squat
instruction: Stand with feet stable. Lower into a comfortable shallow squat. Pause briefly. Stand back up with control.
phases: Stand upright, whole feet planted slightly wider than the hips, hands comfortably in front.
Sit the hips back into a shallow squat, knees tracking the toes and heels planted. Keep the torso long.

name: Hip hinge
instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Soften the knees slightly. Push the hips back. Lower the torso with a straight back. Return to standing by driving the hips forward.
phases: Stand upright with hip-width feet flat, knees slightly soft and arms relaxed.
Hips move backward, torso tips forward as one long line and arms hang freely below shoulders. Keep shins nearly upright.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
instruction: Lie on the back. Bend one knee and keep that foot on the floor. Extend or lift the other leg. Push through the working heel. Lift the hips and lower slowly.
phases: Lie supine, one foot planted under a bent knee and other leg extended clear of floor, hips resting.
Keep the same foot planted and raise hips into alignment with shoulders and supporting knee; free leg stays extended.

name: Glute bridge march
instruction: Start in a glute bridge position. Keep the hips lifted. Lift one foot slightly from the floor. Put it down and switch sides. Keep the pelvis stable.
phases: Hold a bridge with hips level, knees bent and both feet flat.
Lift right foot a little, supporting the bridge with the left foot.
Lift left foot a little, supporting the bridge with the right foot.

name: Glute bridge hold
instruction: Lie on the back. Bend the knees and place the feet on the floor. Lift the hips. Pause at the top. Lower slowly.
phases: Hold the top of a two-foot glute bridge, shoulders and feet on mat, knees bent, hips in line with shoulders and knees.

name: Calf raises
instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Rise onto the balls of the feet. Pause briefly at the top. Lower the heels slowly.
phases: Stand upright with both heels on the floor, toes forward and knees soft.
Rise onto balls of both feet, heels lifted together, ankles upright and posture tall.

name: Side plank leg lift
instruction: Start in a side plank. Keep the body in a straight line. Lift the top leg slightly. Lower it with control. Repeat and switch sides.
phases: Hold a side forearm plank, straight legs stacked, hips lifted.
Lift the top leg a short distance directly sideways, maintaining the trunk line and lower foot support.

name: Air squats
instruction: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart. Push the hips back slightly. Bend the knees and lower into a squat. Keep the chest open. Stand back up through the whole foot.
phases: Stand tall over shoulder-width feet, toes slightly turned out and heels planted.
Sit back and bend knees into a comfortable squat, knees tracking toes, chest open and heels down.

name: Reverse lunges
instruction: Stand tall. Step one leg back. Lower into a lunge with control. Push through the front foot to return to standing. Switch sides.
phases: Stand tall with feet hip-width, knees soft and hands comfortably in front.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, front heel planted and back knee hovering beneath the hip.

name: Slow air squats
instruction: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower over about three seconds. Pause briefly at the bottom. Stand up with control.
phases: Stand tall over shoulder-width feet, toes slightly turned out and heels planted.
Sit back and bend knees into a comfortable squat, knees tracking toes, chest open and heels down.

name: Low pogo jumps
instruction: Stand tall with feet about hip-width apart. Keep the knees slightly soft. Make small quick jumps using mostly the ankles. Land quietly and repeat.
phases: Stand on both feet, knees softly bent and ankles ready to spring.
Both feet clear the ground by a small distance in a low, ankle-driven hop with body upright.

name: Marching high knees
instruction: Stand tall. Lift one knee toward hip height. Lower it with control. Switch sides and continue marching. Keep the arms moving naturally.
phases: March tall, left knee rising toward hip height as right arm comes forward; right foot planted.
Right knee rises and left arm comes forward; left foot planted and supporting.

name: Jumping jacks
instruction: Stand tall with arms by the sides. Jump the feet out while raising the arms overhead. Jump the feet back in while lowering the arms. Repeat with a steady rhythm.
phases: Stand with feet together and arms alongside the body.
Feet land apart as arms rise overhead, knees softly bent and torso upright.

name: Mountain climbers
instruction: Start in a high plank. Keep the hands under the shoulders. Drive one knee toward the chest. Switch legs rhythmically. Keep the hips stable.
phases: High plank, right knee drawn forward beneath torso, left leg extended behind.
Switch: left knee comes forward and right leg extends, hands anchored below shoulders.

name: Squat jumps
instruction: Start with feet about shoulder-width apart. Lower into a controlled squat. Jump upward. Land softly with knees slightly bent. Reset your position before the next jump.
phases: Prepare with feet shoulder-width, knees bent and hips back, arms down.
Jump straight up, feet clearly off the floor and arms reaching upward.
Land on both feet, knees flexed in line with toes and hips back to absorb impact.

name: Skater hops
instruction: Stand on one leg. Hop sideways to the other leg. Land softly and stabilize. Repeat side to side. Use the arms for balance.
phases: Balance on the right foot, right knee softly bent, free leg trailing behind, arms balancing.
Bound sideways with both feet just off floor, arms counterbalancing.
Land and stabilize on the bent left leg, right leg trailing behind.

name: High knees
instruction: Stand tall. Run in place while lifting the knees high. Move the arms naturally. Keep the rhythm quick but controlled.
phases: Running in place, left knee high, right arm forward and right foot returning toward floor.
Running in place, right knee high, left arm forward and left foot returning toward floor.

name: Burpees
instruction: Stand tall. Squat down and place the hands on the floor. Jump or step the feet back into a plank. Jump or step the feet forward. Stand up and finish with a small jump.
phases: Crouch from standing and plant both palms on the floor between the feet.
Extend both legs back to a straight high plank on hands and toes.
After bringing feet under hips, finish in a small upright jump with both feet off the floor.

name: Jump lunges
instruction: Start in a lunge position. Jump upward. Switch legs in the air. Land softly in the opposite lunge. Reset your balance before the next rep.
phases: Low lunge, left foot forward and right knee hovering.
Small vertical jump, legs switching beneath upright body.
Soft opposite lunge landing, right foot forward, left knee hovering.

name: Chest stretch
instruction: Lie on the back. Open the arms out to the sides. Relax the shoulders. Let the chest open gently. Breathe slowly.
phases: Lie on the back, arms open wide on the floor, palms up and shoulders relaxed, chest facing the ceiling.

name: Hamstring stretch
instruction: Lie on the back. Lift one leg. Hold behind the thigh or calf. Pull the leg gently toward you. Switch sides.
phases: Lie supine, one foot planted and the other leg raised. Both hands support the back of its thigh as the knee gently straightens, shoulders resting.

name: Supine twist
instruction: Lie on the back. Bend the knees. Let the knees move gently to one side. Keep the shoulders on the floor. Return to center and switch sides.
phases: Supine with both bent knees resting together to one side, shoulder blades on the floor, arms spread comfortably.

name: Sphinx pose
instruction: Lie on the stomach. Place the forearms on the floor. Lift the chest gently. Keep the neck long. Breathe slowly.
phases: Prone with elbows beneath shoulders and forearms flat, chest gently lifted, pelvis and legs resting, gaze slightly ahead on floor.

name: Lying breathing
instruction: Lie on the back. Relax the shoulders and jaw. Place one hand on the belly if comfortable. Inhale gently. Exhale slowly.
phases: Lie on the back, knees comfortably bent, feet on floor and hands resting on belly, shoulders and head relaxed.

name: Child's pose
instruction: Kneel and sit the hips back toward the heels. Reach the arms forward on the floor. Let the forehead rest down. Breathe slowly and relax.
phases: Kneel with hips toward heels and arms reaching forward on the mat, forehead comfortably down, shoulders relaxed.

name: External shoulder rotation
instruction: Stand tall holding one 0.5 kg dumbbell. Bend the elbow to 90° and pin it to your side. Start with the forearm across your belly. Slowly rotate the forearm outward, away from the body. Return slowly, then switch arms.
phases: Stand with a single small dumbbell in one hand, elbow bent 90 degrees and pinned to side, forearm across belly.
Rotate the forearm outward while keeping the upper arm at the ribs, wrist level and torso facing forward.

name: Bent-over reverse fly
instruction: Hold a 0.5 kg dumbbell in each hand. Hinge at the hips with a straight back and soft knees. Let the arms hang under the shoulders. Raise the arms out to the sides up to shoulder height and squeeze the shoulder blades. Lower slowly.
phases: Hip hinge with back long, knees soft, and one small dumbbell hanging below each shoulder.
Raise both arms out to the sides near shoulder height, elbows soft, torso staying hinged.

name: Goblet squat
instruction: Hold both 0.5 kg dumbbells together at the chest. Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart. Sit the hips back and bend the knees. Keep the heels down and the chest tall. Stand up without letting the weights drift forward.
phases: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips, holding two small dumbbells close together at chest height.
Maintain the same grip at the chest and squat to a comfortable depth with heels down and knees over toes.

name: Overhead dumbbell hold
instruction: Hold a 0.5 kg dumbbell in each hand. Press both arms straight overhead. Bring the biceps close to the ears. Keep the ribs down and the belly tight. Hold still and breathe until the time ends, then lower slowly.
phases: Stand with one small dumbbell in each hand, both arms extended overhead, biceps near ears, ribs down and feet planted.

name: Suitcase hold
instruction: Hold one 0.5 kg dumbbell in one hand, arm hanging by the thigh. Stand with feet under the hips. Stay tall: don't lean toward the weight or away from it. Hold still and breathe. Switch hands for the other side.
phases: Stand upright, feet under hips, one small dumbbell hanging from a straight arm beside thigh; shoulders and pelvis level.

name: Easy walking
instruction: Stand comfortably with clear space around you. Walk in place, lifting your feet only a little. Let your arms move naturally with your steps. Keep an easy pace until the signal.
phases: Easy walk in place: left foot just lifted while right foot supports, right arm forward and shoulders loose.
Right foot just lifted and left foot supports, left arm forward. Take equally small steps.

name: Alternating ankle rocks
instruction: Place one foot slightly in front of the other. Gently move the front knee forward in the direction of your toes. Move the knee back, keeping the heel on the floor. One forward-and-back rock is one repetition; switch legs each time and count the total.
phases: Stand in a short staggered stance with the front sole fully planted and knee over ankle.
Move the front knee forward in line with the toes, keeping the whole front heel down and both feet in place.

name: Knee-over-toe ankle rock
instruction: Place the working foot slightly forward; touch a wall for balance if needed. Slowly move its knee forward in the direction of the toes. Move back to the start; that is one repetition. Complete the assigned repetitions on one leg, then switch yourself and repeat the same number. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Stand in a short staggered stance with the front sole fully planted and knee over ankle.
Move the front knee forward in line with the toes, keeping the whole front heel down and both feet in place.

name: Shoulder circles and arm swings
instruction: Stand comfortably and let your arms hang. Make 4 slow shoulder circles backward, then 4 forward. Make 4 small forward-and-back arm swings; a full out-and-back swing counts as one. Count 12 movements in total. Keep your neck relaxed.
phases: Stand relaxed, arms hanging loose and shoulders slightly elevated during the circular roll.
Both arms swing gently forward with shoulders relaxed.
Both arms swing a little behind the torso; keep feet and chest facing ahead.

name: Hip hinges
instruction: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. Send your hips backward as if closing a drawer behind you. Tip your body a little forward while keeping your back straight. Stand up smoothly to finish one repetition. Count each bend without rushing.
phases: Stand upright with hip-width feet flat, knees slightly soft and arms relaxed.
Hips move backward, torso tips forward as one long line and arms hang freely below shoulders. Keep shins nearly upright.

name: Slow shallow squats
instruction: Stand with feet slightly wider than your hips and hands comfortably in front. Move your hips back a little and softly bend your knees. Lower only a short way, keeping heels on the floor. Stand smoothly to finish one repetition. Count the squats at an easy pace.
phases: Stand upright, whole feet planted slightly wider than the hips, hands comfortably in front.
Sit the hips back into a shallow squat, knees tracking the toes and heels planted. Keep the torso long.

name: Split step, side step and hold
instruction: Stand in the centre with feet slightly wider than hips, soft knees and hands in front. Make a tiny two-foot hop and land softly. Step right and hold a balanced stance for 2 seconds. Return to the centre for one repetition; go left on the next.
phases: Facing ahead in a ready stance, make a tiny split-step hop; both feet just off floor.
Land softly on both feet, a little wider than hips, knees flexed and hands in front.
Take a short side step to the right and settle into the balanced ready stance.

name: Reverse lunge with a pause
instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart; the working leg stays in front. Step the other foot back and lower for 2 seconds, bending both knees. Pause for 1 second at a comfortable depth. Push through the front foot and bring the back foot in for one repetition. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Stand tall with feet hip-width, knees soft and hands comfortably in front.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, front heel planted and back knee hovering beneath the hip.

name: Slow-lowering push-ups
instruction: Place hands slightly wider than shoulders and step feet back; rest on your knees for the easier version. Make a straight line from head to heels, or from head to knees. Bend elbows slightly backward and lower your chest for 2 seconds to a comfortable depth. Press smoothly through your palms to return for one repetition.
phases: High plank, hands slightly wider than shoulders, arms straight, toes supporting.
Lower the whole body until chest nears the mat, elbows angling back and head-to-heel line intact.

name: Prone W raises
instruction: Lie on your stomach facing down; bend your elbows so your arms form a W. Keep your chest low and gently draw your shoulder blades together. Lift hands and elbows just off the floor and hold for 1 second. Lower smoothly for one repetition.
phases: Face down, gaze toward mat, elbows bent in a W with hands and elbows resting.
Lift elbows and hands together a few centimetres, keeping the W and the neck long.

name: Single-leg calf raise
instruction: Stand beside a wall and touch it with your fingertips. Put your weight on the working leg and lift the other foot slightly. Rise onto the ball of the working foot and hold for 1 second. Lower the heel smoothly for one repetition; switch legs after the set. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Stand beside a wall, fingertips lightly touching it, one foot off floor and supporting heel down.
Rise onto the ball of the supporting foot without leaning sideways; free foot stays lifted and fingertips stay on wall.

name: Dead bug
instruction: Lie on your back with arms up and bent knees over your hips. Slowly reach your right arm overhead and straighten your left leg without touching the floor. Return them for one repetition; move only while your lower back stays still. Complete the assigned repetitions with this pair, then switch pairs yourself and do the same number. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Supine, arms pointing up, both knees bent over hips, shins level.
Reach right arm overhead while left leg extends low off the mat; left arm stays up and right knee bent.
Extend left arm and right leg instead; keep the inactive arm upright and the inactive knee bent.

name: Wall calf stretch
instruction: Place your palms on a wall and step one foot back. Bend the front knee slightly and keep the back leg almost straight. Keep the back heel down and gently lean toward the wall. Switch sides at the cue. After the 3, 2, 1 countdown, continue stretching the other calf.
phases: Face wall with palms planted, one leg backward and straight, rear heel on floor. Front knee bends and torso leans gently toward wall.

name: Quiet breathing on your back
instruction: Lie on your back with knees comfortably bent and feet on the floor. Rest your hands beside you or on your belly. Relax your face and shoulders, breathing at your usual pace. After the signal, roll onto your side and get up slowly.
phases: Lie on the back, knees comfortably bent, feet on floor and hands resting on belly, shoulders and head relaxed.

name: Side steps
instruction: Stand in the centre with feet slightly wider than hips and soft knees. Take one or two short side steps to the right. Return to the centre, then take the same steps left. Alternate until the signal, leaving space between your feet.
phases: Face ahead with soft knees, feet hip-width and hands in front at the centre.
Right foot steps sideways right; trailing foot follows without crossing.
Show a short side step to the left, facing forward and maintaining a gap between feet.

name: Compass steps
instruction: Choose a centre point and stand steadily. Step forward and return to the centre. Step right and return, then back and return. Step left and return. All four directions with returns make one repetition.
phases: From the centre, step one foot forward, leaving the other foot near centre.
After returning, show a step to the side, torso facing forward.
After returning, show a step backward with the other foot near centre. Rear foot and its floor contact visible.

name: Single-leg balance
instruction: Stand near a wall in case you need support. Shift weight to one leg and lift the other foot a little. Look at a fixed point ahead and place your arms comfortably. Switch sides yourself halfway through the total time; one timer covers both sides.
phases: Stand upright beside a wall on one softly bent leg. The other foot is slightly lifted, gaze forward, arms comfortable, pelvis level.

name: Cross-body march
instruction: Stand tall with hands loose in front. Raise your left knee and touch it with your right palm. Put it down, then touch your right knee with your left palm. One knee touch followed by putting the foot down is one repetition; alternate and count the total.
phases: March with left knee lifted and right palm touching it across body; right foot planted.
March with right knee lifted and left palm touching it across body; left foot planted.

name: Tennis preparation turn
instruction: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips, soft knees and hands in front. Slowly turn shoulders and hips toward the working side. Allow your feet to pivot a little with your body. Return to face forward for one repetition; switch sides after the set. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Stand facing forward with feet slightly wide, knees soft and empty hands in front.
Turn hips and shoulders together toward one side, allowing feet to pivot lightly, hands following trunk.

name: Gentle cat stretch
instruction: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Breathe out and gently round your back, looking toward the mat. Breathe in and return to a straight back without a deep arch. One rounding and return counts as one repetition.
phases: On all fours, hands beneath shoulders and knees under hips, back level.
Exhale and gently round the spine upward, gaze down toward mat, arms staying straight.

name: Side-lying open book
instruction: Lie on your side with bent knees together and arms straight in front, palms together. Slowly open the top arm sideways and slightly behind you, following it with your eyes. Keep knees together and move only as far as comfortable. Bring the palms together for one repetition; change sides after the set. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Side-lying with knees bent and stacked, both arms straight forward and palms touching.
Open top arm backward and turn chest and eyes toward that hand, keeping bent knees stacked.

name: Hands-and-knees rock back
instruction: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees comfortably under hips. Keep hands in place and slowly move hips toward your heels. Stop before any discomfort in your knees or back. Rock forward to the start for one repetition.
phases: Start on all fours with back long and hips over knees.
Keeping both palms planted, rock hips backward toward heels, arms reaching long and spine relaxed.

name: Lying hamstring stretch
instruction: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and lift the other leg bent. Hold the back of the raised thigh, not the knee. Gently straighten that leg until you feel a light stretch behind the thigh. Halfway through the total time, bend and lower the leg, then switch yourself; one timer covers both sides.
phases: Lie supine, one foot planted and the other leg raised. Both hands support the back of its thigh as the knee gently straightens, shoulders resting.

name: Lateral hop and hold
instruction: Stand in the centre with feet hip-width apart and soft knees. Bend a little and make a small two-foot hop to the right. Land softly on both feet, bend your knees and hold for 2 seconds. That is one repetition; hop back left on the next.
phases: Face ahead with both feet hip-width and knees soft at centre.
Both feet lift a little in a small sideways hop.
Land slightly to the right on both feet and hold with knees bent, chest upright.

name: Squat with light dumbbells
instruction: Hold one 0.5 kg dumbbell in each hand, close together in front of your chest and clear of your chin. With feet slightly wider than hips, move hips back a little and lower for 3 seconds. Pause for 1 second at a comfortable depth with heels down. Stand smoothly for one repetition.
phases: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips, holding two small dumbbells close together at chest height.
Maintain the same grip at the chest and squat to a comfortable depth with heels down and knees over toes.

name: Bent-over dumbbell row
instruction: Hold a 0.5 kg dumbbell in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart. Soften your knees, send hips back and lean forward with a straight back and hanging arms. Pull elbows backward toward your hips and hold the weights beside you for 1 second. Lower your arms smoothly for one repetition.
phases: In a hip hinge with back long, hold one small 0.5 kg dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging down.
Draw elbows back toward hips, bringing dumbbells beside torso without straightening the body.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
instruction: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms on the floor. Keep the working foot down and lift the other leg with its knee bent. Press through the working foot and lift hips into a shoulder–hip–knee line; hold for 1 second. Lower smoothly for one repetition; switch the supporting leg after the set. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Supine, arms at sides, working foot planted and other knee bent with that foot raised; hips on mat.
Lift hips into a line from shoulders through hips to supporting knee, free knee still bent.

name: Side plank from bent knees
instruction: Lie on your side, bend your knees and place the lower elbow beneath your shoulder. Press through your forearm and lower knee to lift your hips. Keep a straight shoulder–hip–knee line and breathe calmly. Halfway through the total time, lower your hips and switch sides yourself; one timer covers both sides.
phases: Hold side plank on a forearm and lower knee. Both knees bent, hips elevated into a straight shoulder–hip–knee line, upper hand on hip.

name: Step over a line and back
instruction: Imagine a line on the floor in front of your feet. Step the right foot across, then bring the left across, leaving space between them. Step the right foot back behind the line, then the left. Both feet across and back make one repetition; lead with the left foot in the next round.
phases: Face forward just behind a flat line with both feet hip-width.
Step one foot across the line, leaving the trailing foot planted behind.
Bring the trailing foot over, both feet beyond the line and still hip-width.

name: V-shaped diagonal steps
instruction: Stand in the centre with slightly bent knees. Step your right foot diagonally forward-right, then bring it back to centre. Step your left foot forward-left and bring it back. One diagonal step and return make one repetition; alternate sides and count the total.
phases: Face forward at centre, knees soft, hands in front.
Right foot steps diagonally forward-right while left foot stays anchored.
After returning to centre, left foot steps diagonally forward-left while right foot stays anchored.

name: Foot rhythm: two slow, four quick
instruction: Stand comfortably with soft knees. Take two slow steps in place, right then left. Take four short, quick steps, alternating feet. Repeat the two-slow, four-quick pattern until the signal.
phases: Stand tall stepping in place, right foot a little higher for a slow step and left foot planted.
Switch to a slow left step with right foot planted.
Show a short quick step with the lifted foot low and the standing knee soft, arms counterbalancing.

name: Single-leg three-way toe taps
instruction: Stand on the working support leg with a soft knee; stay near a wall if needed. Lightly tap the free toes in front, then bring them back beside the standing foot. Tap to the side and then behind, returning between taps. The full three-tap sequence is one repetition; switch the standing leg after the set. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Balance on one softly bent leg and tap free toes lightly ahead of supporting foot.
Same supporting foot stays planted while free toes tap the floor out to the side.
Same supporting foot stays planted while the free toes tap behind.

name: Side step, preparation turn and return
instruction: Start at the centre in a ready stance with feet slightly wider than hips and soft knees. Take a short step toward the working side and plant the foot steadily. Gently turn shoulders and hips that way, allowing your feet to pivot a little. Face forward and step back to centre for one repetition; switch sides after the set. The shown count is for each side. Count yourself and tap Done only after both sides.
phases: Start in a ready stance facing forward, feet slightly wider than hips.
Take a short side step to the right and plant the right foot, still facing forward.
Pivot feet slightly and turn hips and chest toward the stepped side, hands following the trunk.

name: Quick lateral shuffles
instruction: Place two flat marks 60–80 cm apart with clear space around them. Stand between them facing forward with slightly bent knees. Use short, quick shuffle steps towards the right mark. Keep space between your feet. Brake softly, then move straight back towards the left mark. Keep changing direction until the timer ends. Use the fastest pace that keeps your steps short and accurate.
phases: Face ahead between two flat marks, feet apart, knees slightly bent.
Shuffle right with leading foot near right mark and trailing foot following without crossing.
Brake and shuffle left toward left mark, feet still uncrossed, hips low.

name: Quick steps over a line
instruction: Mark a short, flat line on the floor. Stand behind it with feet hip-width apart and soft knees. Quickly step your right foot over the line and bring it back beside your left foot. Then step your left foot over the line and bring it back. Keep alternating feet until the timer ends. Take frequent low steps close to the line. Keep your body steady and look slightly ahead.
phases: Stand facing forward just behind the flat line, both feet hip-width.
Step right foot just over the line, left foot stays behind.
Right foot returns behind the line and left foot steps just over it.

name: Quick feet and direction reaction
instruction: Stand in the centre of your clear space facing the screen. Feet slightly wider than hips, knees soft and hands in front. Take frequent small steps in place. The first random left or right cue comes after 3 seconds of movement; the gaps then gradually shorten from 3 seconds to 1 second. On the cue, take one short step in that direction, brake softly and return straight to the centre. Resume quick feet in place when you return. During the final 3 seconds, keep stepping in place to the countdown without new direction cues. Left and right mean your own left and right.
phases: Face forward at centre, feet close to the floor in a small quick step, hands in front.
Take a short step to the right and absorb the weight on the bent right knee.
After returning to centre take a short step to the left, facing ahead and braking softly.

name: Short-step jogging in place
instruction: Stand in the middle of a nonslip mat with your elbows slightly bent. Jog in place, lifting your feet a little one at a time and landing softly. Let your arms help the movement; keep your body upright and look ahead. Keep the assigned pace until the timer ends; your knees only need to rise a little.
phases: Jog in place with left foot just off floor, right arm forward and torso upright.
Jog in place with right foot just off floor, left arm forward; low knees and relaxed shoulders.

name: Squat with a bottom pause
instruction: Stand with feet slightly wider than your hips, toes a little outward and hands in front. Take one second to move your hips back and bend your knees to a comfortable depth. Pause for one second with your whole foot planted and knees pointing with your toes. Stand up smoothly in one second for one repetition. Count your repetitions and press Done after the set.
phases: Stand upright, whole feet planted slightly wider than the hips, hands comfortably in front.
Sit the hips back into a shallow squat, knees tracking the toes and heels planted. Keep the torso long.

name: Plank with shoulder taps
instruction: Place your hands under your shoulders, straighten your legs and set your feet wider than your hips. Keep a line from head to heels and shift a little weight onto one hand. Tap the opposite shoulder with the other hand, then return it calmly to the floor. Change hands. One tap and return is one repetition, taking about 2 seconds. Count both hands together and press Done after all repetitions.
phases: High plank, both hands under shoulders, feet slightly wide, hips level.
Right hand rests briefly on left shoulder, supported by left palm and both feet.
Left hand rests on right shoulder, supported by right palm and both feet. Body stays square.

name: Forearm plank with small foot lifts
instruction: Put your elbows under your shoulders, support yourself on forearms and toes, and line up your body. Keep your hips level and lift one foot just 2–3 cm. Hold it briefly, lower it smoothly and then lift the other foot. One lift and return is one repetition, taking about 3 seconds. Count both legs together and press Done after all repetitions.
phases: Straight forearm plank, both toes on floor, elbows beneath shoulders, pelvis level.
Lift one foot just 2–3 cm, leg long and pelvis unchanged.
Opposite foot hovers 2–3 cm as the first returns to the mat.

name: Side plank with staggered feet
instruction: Lie on your side, put the lower elbow under your shoulder and straighten your legs. Place the upper foot slightly in front of the lower foot so both touch the floor. Press through your forearm and feet, lifting your hips into line with shoulders and legs. Put the upper hand on your hip. Hold and breathe. Lower your hips and change sides on the cue; the combined timer covers both sides.
phases: Hold a side forearm plank with elbow under shoulder, upper foot slightly in front of lower and both touching floor, upper hand resting on hip.

name: Lateral lunge
instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands in front. Make room for a step to the side. Step sideways, push your hips back and bend the leg you stepped with. Point that knee in the same direction as your toes. Keep your other leg straight without a strong stretch. Keep both feet on the floor. Push through the bent leg to return to standing. One step out and return is one rep, taking about three seconds. Complete the shown number on each leg, then tap Done.
phases: Stand hip-width, hands comfortably in front and toes forward.
Step sideways, shift hips back, bend the stepping knee over toes, keep the other leg straight and both feet planted.

name: Two steps forward and back
instruction: Stand in the middle of a clear space, feet hip-width apart, knees soft and hands in front. Take two short steps forward, then two short steps back to your starting place. Keep your body facing forward. Repeat starting with the other foot. Continue until the timer ends, leaving clear space in front and behind.
phases: Stand at centre facing forward with knees soft.
Take a small forward step, other foot trailing; body still facing forward.
From the forward position take a small backward step toward centre, same body orientation throughout.

name: Squat and calf raise
instruction: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, hands in front and heels on the floor. Move your hips slightly back and squat to a comfortable depth, keeping knees aligned with toes. Stand up, then rise smoothly onto your toes and lower your heels. The whole sequence is one repetition; take about three seconds.
phases: Stand with both feet flat, about shoulder-width, hands in front.
Sit back into a comfortable squat with heels down and knees tracking toes.
Stand tall and finish rising onto both forefeet with both heels lifted.

name: Single-leg hip hinge
instruction: Stand on one leg with a soft supporting knee. Keep the free leg close and use your arms for balance if needed. Slowly move your hips back and tip your torso forward as the free leg reaches back. Keep your back long and hips facing the floor. Stop at a small comfortable depth and return to standing. One hinge and return is one repetition, taking about three seconds. The count is for each leg. Complete both sides before pressing Done.
phases: Balance upright on one softly bent leg, free foot a little above floor, arms out comfortably.
Hinge the torso forward as the free leg reaches back, hips square and back long, support foot planted.

name: Prone Y–T–W arm lifts
instruction: Lie on your front, look down at the mat and keep your neck long. Rest your legs and keep your chest low. Reach your arms diagonally forward into a Y, lift them slightly and lower. Move them out to a T and repeat; then bend your elbows into a W and repeat. One lift, brief hold and lower is one repetition, taking about three seconds. Keep cycling Y, T, W to the displayed total: 12 repetitions give four of each shape.
phases: Prone with neck long, chest low and both arms lifted slightly on diagonals overhead: Y.
Keep chest low and lift the straight arms outward at shoulder height: T.
Bend elbows and lift the hands and elbows slightly into a W shape beside the upper back.

name: Stationary split squat
instruction: Place one foot forward and the other back, keeping hip-width space between them as if on two rails. The rear heel is raised. Bend both knees and lower to a comfortable depth. Keep the front heel down and the front knee pointing with the toes. Press the front foot into the floor and rise, leaving both feet in place. Lowering and rising is one repetition, taking about three seconds. The count is for each leg. Complete both sides before pressing Done.
phases: Stand in a fixed split stance with a hip-width gap side-to-side, back heel raised and front foot flat.
Lower straight down by bending both knees; same foot placement, front knee tracks toes, back knee hovers.

name: Forearm plank with alternating side steps
instruction: Set up a forearm plank with elbows below shoulders, body in a straight line and feet slightly wider than hips. Step one foot a small distance sideways and return it. Keep your shoulders and hips steady. Repeat with the other leg. One foot out and back is one repetition; alternate legs and count the total. Take about three seconds for each repetition.
phases: Hold forearm plank with feet slightly wider than hips, elbows under shoulders.
Step right toes a little farther sideways, hips square, left foot stationary.
Return right foot and show left toes stepped out to the left, shoulders and hips level.

name: Continuous diagonal steps and return
instruction: Stand in the centre, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent and hands in front. Step your right foot a little forward-right and return it to the centre. Then step the left foot forward-left and return. Keep alternating until the timer ends. Take short, low steps and keep your body facing forward.
phases: Face forward at centre, knees soft, hands in front.
Right foot steps diagonally forward-right while left foot stays anchored.
After returning to centre, left foot steps diagonally forward-left while right foot stays anchored.

name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
instruction: Kneel on one knee on a padded mat. Place your other foot in front, roughly below that knee, with your legs hip-width apart. Keep your torso upright and place your hands on your hips. Gently tuck your pelvis: tip an imaginary belt buckle slightly upward. Move your hips a little forward until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the back hip. Keep your lower back in its natural position. When the app says “Change sides”, gently change legs. After “three, two, one”, hold the other side.
phases: Half-kneeling, front foot below front knee, back knee padded. Hold torso upright with hands at hips, pelvis slightly tucked and hips shifted gently forward.

name: Standing quad stretch by a wall
instruction: Stand sideways to a wall and support yourself with the nearer palm. Keep your standing knee slightly soft. Bend the leg farther from the wall behind you. With your free hand, hold the ankle on the same side; keep your knees close together. Bring your heel gently toward your bottom until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the thigh. The bent knee points down and your hips and torso stay upright. When the app says “Change sides”, gently release your leg and turn your other side toward the wall. Change your supporting hand and leg; after “three, two, one”, hold the other side.
phases: Stand sideways to a wall with nearer hand on it. Bend outside knee, same-side hand holding ankle behind, knees close, bent knee pointing down, torso tall.

name: Lying figure-four glute stretch
instruction: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet on the mat. Rest one ankle on the opposite thigh, just above the knee. Reach one hand between your legs and the other around the outside. Hold the back of the thigh that supports the ankle. Gently draw that thigh a little toward you until you feel a mild stretch in the crossed leg’s buttock. Keep your head and shoulders on the mat; let the crossed knee point comfortably outward. When the app says “Change sides”, gently change legs. After “three, two, one”, hold the other side.
phases: Lie supine, one ankle crossed above opposite knee. Hold behind the supporting thigh with both hands and draw it closer, crossed knee opening out, head down.

name: Child’s pose: gentle back stretch
instruction: Start on hands and knees on a padded mat. Place your knees comfortably apart and keep your feet close together. Slowly move your hips back toward your heels only as far as feels comfortable. Keep your palms forward, shoulder-width apart, and gently reach through your arms. Lower your chest toward the mat without forcing. If comfortable, rest your forehead on the mat or a folded towel and relax your neck. Hold calmly until the end signal. Then ease back onto hands and knees.
phases: Kneel with hips toward heels and arms reaching forward on the mat, forehead comfortably down, shoulders relaxed.

name: Chest stretch with forearm on wall
instruction: Stand sideways beside a wall. Place the nearer foot a little ahead of the other in a comfortable stance. Rest the nearer forearm and palm on the wall with your fingers pointing up. Keep your elbow slightly below your shoulder and your shoulder relaxed and down. Slowly turn your chest and hips a little away from the wall until you feel a mild chest stretch. Use a small movement, keeping your arm on the wall without taking it far behind you. When the app says “Change sides”, gently release your arm and turn your other side toward the wall. Place your other forearm; after “three, two, one”, hold the other side.
phases: Stand sideways to wall with nearer forearm and palm resting on it, fingers up, elbow just below shoulder. Turn body slightly away, keeping near shoulder relaxed.

name: Dead hang
instruction: Stand on a chair under the bar and grip it overhand, shoulder-width or slightly wider. Hang with straight arms. At first, your toes may touch the chair. Gently engage your shoulders: draw them down, not up to your ears. Relax your legs and keep your body still. At the end, step onto the chair before you let go.
phases: Hang still from secure overhead bar with hands overhand just beyond shoulder-width, arms long, shoulders engaged, stable chair beneath for access.

name: Scapular pull-ups
instruction: Hang from the bar on straight arms, overhand grip, slightly wider than your shoulders. Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and slightly back. Your body rises a few centimetres. Pause for a second. Slowly lower back to a full hang. Repeat for the reps, then step onto the chair and let go.
phases: Hang from a secure bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and shoulders in a natural high position.
Without bending elbows, draw shoulder blades down and slightly back, raising body just a few centimetres.

name: Negative pull-ups
instruction: Step onto a stable chair so your chin is above the bar, arms bent, overhand grip. Take your feet off the chair and hang. Lower yourself slowly over 3–5 seconds until your arms are straight. Step back onto the chair for the next rep. After the last rep, stand on the chair and let go.
phases: Hold the top position at a secure bar with overhand grip, chin above bar, elbows bent, feet just clear of a stable chair.
Lower through a midrange position with elbows partly open, body quiet and feet free.
Finish hanging with arms long, feet beside stable chair ready to step back onto it.

name: Flexed-arm hang
instruction: Step onto a stable chair and grip the bar overhand. Bring your chin above the bar with elbows bent and chest close to the bar. Lift your feet off the chair and hold the position. Keep your shoulders down and your body still. At the end, step back onto the chair and let go.
phases: Hold chin above a secure horizontal bar in an overhand grip, elbows bent, shoulders down and feet lifted clear of stable access chair.

name: Assisted pull-ups with feet on a chair
instruction: Place a sturdy chair under or in front of the bar and put your feet on it. Grip the bar overhand, slightly wider than your shoulders. Pull your chest toward the bar with your arms, using your legs only as much as needed. Lower slowly until your arms are straight. Repeat for the reps, then let go and stand on the chair.
phases: Grip secure overhead bar with straight arms, feet supported on a sturdy chair, knees bent.
Pull chest up toward bar, elbows drawing down, feet remaining supported on same chair for assistance.

name: Pull-ups
instruction: Grip the bar overhand, slightly wider than your shoulders. Hang with straight arms and keep your shoulders away from your ears. Pull up, driving your elbows down, until your chin is above the bar. Lower with control until your arms are fully straight. Repeat, then tap Done.
phases: Hang on a secure horizontal bar, overhand grip a little wider than shoulders, arms long.
Pull up with elbows down until chin clears bar, body controlled and feet off the floor.

name: Inverted row under a table
instruction: Check that the table is sturdy and stable, then lie under it. Grip the table edge shoulder-width apart. Plant your heels on the floor and keep your body straight from head to heels. Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower slowly, repeat, then tap Done.
phases: Lie under a sturdy table, both hands gripping its edge, arms long, heels planted, head-to-heels line straight.
Pull chest toward table edge with elbows bending, heels staying planted and hips aligned.

name: Chair dips
instruction: Place a stable chair against a wall and sit on its edge. Put your hands next to your hips with fingers pointing forward. Slide your hips off the seat, knees bent and feet on the floor. Bend your elbows to about 90° and keep your back close to the chair. Press up to straight arms, repeat, then tap Done.
phases: Plant a stable chair against wall. Grip front edge beside hips, fingers forward, hips just off seat, knees bent and elbows straight.
With feet planted and back close to chair, bend elbows backward to a comfortable angle and lower hips.

name: Knee push-ups
instruction: Kneel on a mat with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders. Make a straight line from your head to your knees. Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor. Press back up to straight arms. Repeat, then tap Done.
phases: Kneel with palms slightly wider than shoulders and arms straight, knees on mat, head-to-knee line straight.
Bend elbows back and lower chest toward mat, rotating through knees while hips stay aligned.

name: Short side plank with knee on a chair
instruction: Lie on your side next to a chair, forearm under your shoulder. Rest your top knee on the chair seat. Lift your hips so your body is straight from shoulder to knee. Let the bottom leg hang or lift it slightly. Hold the position and breathe steadily. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other side.
phases: Side-on beside a stable chair, top knee supported by seat and lower forearm on floor under shoulder. Hips lifted to a shoulder–hip–top-knee line, lower leg clear.

name: Wall sit
instruction: Stand with your back against a wall, feet hip-width apart and slightly forward. Slide down until your knees are bent to about 90°. Keep your knees over your ankles and your back flat on the wall. Hold the position and breathe steadily. Then slide up slowly and stand.
phases: Hold a wall sit, back against wall, feet hip-width and flat with ankles beneath knees, hips and knees bent near right angles.

name: Standing forward fold
instruction: Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Soften your knees and hinge forward at the hips. Let your torso, head and arms hang toward your legs. Hold a mild stretch along the back of your legs. To come out, slowly roll up one vertebra at a time.
phases: Stand feet hip-width, knees soft. Fold forward from hips with torso draped over thighs, head and arms hanging comfortably.

name: Seated forward fold
instruction: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and together. Bend your knees slightly if you need to. Lengthen your back and hinge forward from the hips. Reach toward your shins or feet as far as is comfortable. Hold a mild stretch and breathe calmly.
phases: Sit with both legs straight together, knees soft, torso folded gently forward from hips with long back, hands resting near shins.

name: Butterfly stretch
instruction: Sit tall and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall out to the sides and hold your ankles. Lengthen your spine upward. Gently lean forward from the hips until you feel a mild stretch in your inner thighs. Hold the position and breathe calmly.
phases: Sit with soles together, knees open outward, hands around ankles and chest long, inclining a little forward from hips.

name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
instruction: Kneel on one knee on a padded mat with the other foot in front. Tuck your pelvis slightly and draw your belly in. Gently shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip. Keep your torso upright with your hands on the front thigh or your waist. Breathe calmly and hold the position. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other side.
phases: Half-kneeling, front foot below front knee, back knee padded. Hold torso upright with hands at hips, pelvis slightly tucked and hips shifted gently forward.

name: Pigeon stretch
instruction: Start on hands and knees and bring one knee forward behind the same wrist. Angle the shin across the mat and extend the back leg behind you. Square your hips so they face forward. Stay upright on your hands or lower onto your forearms. Breathe calmly and hold a mild stretch in the glute. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other side.
phases: In pigeon stretch, front knee bent with shin angled across mat, back leg extended behind. Hips face forward, hands resting on floor, chest long.

name: Frog stretch
instruction: Start on hands and knees on a soft mat. Widen your knees to the sides to a comfortable distance. Place your ankles in line with your knees, feet turned outward. Lower onto your forearms. Gently shift your hips back until you feel a mild stretch in your inner thighs. Hold the position and breathe calmly.
phases: On a padded mat, knees comfortably wide apart, ankles in line with knees, feet turned outward, weight on forearms and hips eased slightly back.

name: Seated straddle fold
instruction: Sit on the floor with your legs wide apart, toes pointing up. Lengthen your back and place your palms on the floor in front of you. Walk your hands forward from your hips, folding with a long back. Stop at a mild stretch in the inner and back thighs. Hold the position and breathe evenly.
phases: Sit on floor with legs open in a comfortable straddle and toes up, back long, torso gently hinged forward, hands on floor in front.

name: Side lunge stretch
instruction: Stand with your feet wide, toes forward or turned slightly out. Bend one knee and shift your hips toward it, keeping the other leg straight. Place your hands on the bent thigh or the floor and keep your back straight. Feel a mild stretch in the inner thigh of the straight leg. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other side.
phases: Stand wide; hold hips shifted to one side over a bent knee, opposite leg straight, both soles grounded, hands on bent thigh and back long.

name: Half split
instruction: Start in a lunge with the back knee on the floor. Shift your hips back over the back knee and straighten the front leg, toes up. Place your hands on the floor or on blocks beside your leg. Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel a mild stretch. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other leg.
phases: Half split with back knee grounded beneath hips, front leg long, heel planted and toes raised, hands beside front leg and back long in a gentle hinge.

name: Supported front split prep
instruction: Start in a lunge and place your hands on the floor or on a stack of books beside the front leg. Slide the front heel forward and the back knee backward. Keep your weight on your hands and lower only to a mild stretch. Keep your hips square, facing forward. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other side.
phases: Hold a supported partial front split with hands resting on stable blocks beside front leg, front heel forward and back knee behind, pelvis square and high enough for a mild stretch.

name: Wide-stance forward fold
instruction: Stand with your feet wide, toes slightly in, knees soft. Fold forward from the hips with a long back. Lower your hands to the floor, your shins or blocks. Feel a mild stretch in the inner and back thighs and hold. Come up slowly with a flat back.
phases: Wide-legged standing forward fold, toes slightly in, knees soft, torso hinged from hips and hands resting on shins or floor.

name: Standing quad stretch
instruction: Stand next to a wall and rest one hand on it for balance. Bend one knee and hold your ankle behind you. Bring your knees together and tuck your pelvis slightly. Feel a mild stretch at the front of the thigh and hold. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other leg.
phases: Stand sideways to a wall with nearer hand on it. Bend outside knee, same-side hand holding ankle behind, knees close, bent knee pointing down, torso tall.

name: Lying figure-four stretch
instruction: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee. Hold behind the thigh of the bottom leg. Gently draw it toward your chest and hold. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Lie supine, one ankle crossed above opposite knee. Hold behind the supporting thigh with both hands and draw it closer, crossed knee opening out, head down.

name: Deep squat hold
instruction: Set your feet slightly wider than your hips, toes turned out a little. Slowly sink into a deep squat as far as is comfortable. Keep your heels down; a folded towel under them is fine. Place your elbows inside your knees and lift your chest. Hold the position and breathe calmly.
phases: Hold a comfortable deep squat with whole feet planted slightly wider than hips, elbows inside knees, palms together and chest lifted.

name: Cat-cow
instruction: Get on hands and knees: hands under shoulders, knees under hips. Exhale and round your back like a cat, lowering your head. Inhale and gently arch your back, looking forward. Move slowly, one section of the spine at a time. Keep a smooth rhythm for all the reps, then tap Done.
phases: On hands and knees, round spine upward in cat, head lowered and pelvis tucked.
With hands and knees unmoved, gently arch spine into cow, tilting pelvis and lifting gaze slightly forward.

name: Calf stretch at a wall
instruction: Place your hands on a wall and step one foot back. Bend the front knee and keep the back leg straight. Press the back heel into the floor. Lean forward until you feel a stretch in the back calf. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other leg.
phases: Face wall with palms planted, one leg backward and straight, rear heel on floor. Front knee bends and torso leans gently toward wall.

name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
instruction: Stand tall and drop your shoulders. Straighten one arm and bring it across your chest. Hold it above the elbow with your other hand. Gently draw the arm toward your chest and hold. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other arm.
phases: Stand tall, one straight arm across chest, other hand gently holding upper arm above elbow, shoulders relaxed.

name: Overhead triceps stretch
instruction: Raise one arm overhead. Bend the elbow so your hand reaches between your shoulder blades. Gently hold the elbow with your other hand. Keep your head upright and hold the stretch. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other arm.
phases: Stand tall with one arm overhead, elbow bent and hand down between shoulder blades. Other hand lightly supports raised elbow.

name: Thread the needle
instruction: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Slide one arm under your body along the floor, palm up. Lower that shoulder and the side of your head to the mat, and let the other hand support you. Keep the hips level over the knees and breathe calmly. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: From kneeling, thread one arm under torso, palm up, shoulder and side of head resting on mat, other hand supporting and hips over knees.

name: Standing side bend
instruction: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Reach one arm overhead and let the other hang relaxed. Lean gently to the opposite side, lengthening along your side. Keep the hips level and still, and breathe calmly. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Stand with feet hip-width and knees soft. Reach one arm overhead while bending gently toward the opposite side, other arm resting, hips level.

name: Legs up the wall
instruction: Sit sideways right next to a wall and lie back. Swing your legs up the wall and keep your hips close to it. Keep the knees soft and your arms relaxed by your sides. Relax your neck and shoulders and breathe slowly. To come out, bend your knees and roll gently onto your side.
phases: Lie on back near a wall with both legs extending up wall, knees softly bent and arms resting on floor beside body.

name: Knees to chest
instruction: Lie on your back with your knees bent. Bring both knees toward your chest. Hold behind your thighs or on your shins. Let your lower back relax into the floor, with your head resting down. If you like, rock gently from side to side.
phases: Lie supine with head resting and both knees drawn toward chest, hands holding shins or behind thighs, lower back relaxed.

name: Neck side stretch
instruction: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders low and relaxed. Slowly tilt your head so the ear moves toward the shoulder. If you like, rest a hand on your head without pulling. Breathe calmly and hold a mild stretch along the neck. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Sit tall with shoulders relaxed. Hold head gently tilted sideways with ear moving toward shoulder, eyes forward and no lifting of the shoulder.

name: Chin tucks
instruction: Sit or stand tall and look straight ahead. Keep your shoulders low and relaxed. Glide your head straight back, as if making a double chin. Don't tilt your head up or down. Hold for a second, release smoothly and repeat.
phases: Side view seated upright, gaze level and neck neutral.
Glide the head straight backward, making a small chin tuck without angling the chin upward or downward.

name: Slow neck turns
instruction: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders. Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder. Return to the centre and do all the reps to this side. Then repeat the same way to the other side. When both sides are done, tap Done.
phases: Sit upright, chin level, shoulders low and gaze forward.
Rotate the head comfortably to one side to look over that shoulder, leaving torso facing forward.

name: Shoulder rolls
instruction: Stand or sit tall with your arms relaxed at your sides. Lift your shoulders toward your ears. Roll them smoothly backward. Lower them down to complete the circle. Repeat without rushing, then tap Done.
phases: Stand or sit tall with arms hanging and shoulders down.
Roll both shoulders up toward ears, head steady.
Draw shoulders back and down to complete roll, arms loose.

name: Seated chair twist
instruction: Sit near the front of a stable chair with your feet flat on the floor. Turn your chest to one side, holding the backrest or your thigh. Grow tall on the inhale and twist a little more on the exhale. Keep your knees pointing forward. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Sit forward on a stable chair with feet flat, knees facing ahead. Hold a gentle torso turn with hands on thigh and backrest, neck long.

name: Chest opener with hands behind the back
instruction: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back, or hold a towel. Draw your shoulder blades together. Gently lift your hands away from your back as your chest opens. Keep your chin level and look straight ahead. Hold the position and breathe calmly.
phases: Stand upright, chin level, hands clasped behind pelvis and lifted slightly away from back, shoulder blades gently drawn together.

name: Wrist and forearm stretch
instruction: Extend one arm forward with the palm up. With the other hand, gently draw the fingers back toward you. Turn the palm down and draw the back of the hand toward you. Keep the elbow straight but not locked. Then stretch the other arm the same way.
phases: Hold one arm forward, elbow long and palm up. Gently draw the fingers down and back with the other hand, stretching the palm side of the forearm. Shoulders stay low.
Keep the same arm forward and turn the palm down. Flex the wrist so the fingers point toward the floor and use the other hand to draw the back of the hand gently toward the body.

name: Single-leg stand
instruction: Stand tall next to a wall or a stable chair. Lift one foot slightly off the floor. Look at a fixed point ahead and hold your balance. Touch the support only if you need it. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other leg.
phases: Stand upright beside a wall on one softly bent leg. The other foot is slightly lifted, gaze forward, arms comfortable, pelvis level.

name: Heel-to-toe walk
instruction: Stand tall next to a wall. Place the heel of one foot right in front of the toes of the other. Keep your arms relaxed or slightly out to the sides. Look ahead and walk slowly, heel to toe. At the end of the line, turn carefully and walk back.
phases: Walk heel to toe near a wall, left heel placed in line just in front of right toes, gaze forward.
