Place right heel directly ahead of left toes on same line, arms slightly out for balance.

name: Single-leg hip hinge
instruction: Stand next to a wall and touch it for support if needed. Shift your weight onto one leg and soften the knee. Hinge forward from the hip as the other leg extends back, keeping your back long. Return upright with control. Do all reps on one side, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Balance upright on one softly bent leg, free foot a little above floor, arms out comfortably.
Hinge the torso forward as the free leg reaches back, hips square and back long, support foot planted.

name: Sit-to-stand from a chair
instruction: Check that the chair is stable and will not slide; put it against a wall if you can. Sit on the front half of the chair with your feet hip-width apart. Lean slightly forward and stand up, without using your hands if possible. Stand fully upright for a second. Sit back down slowly and with control.
phases: Sit on front half of stable chair, feet hip-width and planted, hands free.
Lean the torso a little forward as hips lift clear of seat and body weight shifts onto feet.
Stand upright in front of the same chair, hips and knees extended, feet unchanged.

name: Standing side leg raise
instruction: Stand tall, holding a stable chair or a wall. Point your toes forward and keep your torso upright. Slowly lift one straight leg out to the side a short way. Lower the leg with control. Do all reps on one side, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand beside stable chair with one hand resting on back, feet close and toes forward.
Lift the outside straight leg laterally a short distance, hips level and torso upright.

name: Single-leg calf raise with support
instruction: Stand by a wall and hold it with one hand. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other slightly. Rise high onto the ball of the standing foot and pause for a second. Lower slowly until the whole foot is on the floor. Do all reps on one side, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand beside a wall, fingertips lightly touching it, one foot off floor and supporting heel down.
Rise onto the ball of the supporting foot without leaning sideways; free foot stays lifted and fingertips stay on wall.

name: Ankle circles
instruction: Stand holding a support, or sit on a stable chair. Lift one foot slightly off the floor. Slowly draw circles with your toes in one direction. Then draw circles in the other direction. Do all reps on one side, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Seated on a stable chair, working foot clear of floor, shin still, toes tracing the top of a small circle.
Same leg and camera, toes point outward near side of circle.
Same leg, toes point down on lower arc of circle; keep lower leg steady.

name: Tai chi opening
instruction: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, arms relaxed. As you inhale, float your arms forward and up to shoulder height. As you exhale, sink slightly and lower your palms to your hips. Keep repeating this cycle slowly and continuously for the whole time.
phases: Stand shoulder-width, knees soft and arms resting in front of hips.
Both arms float forward to shoulder height with soft elbows and wrists.
Sink gently through knees, bringing both palms down near hips.

name: Cloud hands
instruction: Stand with feet wider than your hips, knees soft, one hand at face height and the other at waist height. Shift your weight to one leg and turn the waist smoothly, letting the arms follow. Your hands circle in front of the body and swap heights; your eyes follow the upper hand. Shift your weight the other way, then keep repeating slowly and continuously for the whole time.
phases: Wide soft stance, weight left, torso turned left, left hand near face and right hand near waist.
Shift through centre as hands trace crossing circular paths in front of body.
Shift weight right, torso turned right, right hand high and left low, gaze following upper hand.

name: Parting the wild horse's mane
instruction: Sink slightly with your hands in front of you as if holding a ball. Slowly step forward diagonally into a bow stance and part your hands: the front hand rises to eye level, the back hand presses down by the hip. Shift your weight back smoothly, gather the hands again and repeat, breathing evenly. Keep repeating slowly and continuously. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Soft-kneed stance, arms gathered in front as though cradling a ball.
Step diagonally into a bow stance, separating arms, front hand near eye level and rear hand low by hip.
Shift weight back and gather the hands again over the rear leg.

name: Brush knee and push
instruction: Stand with soft knees, one hand by your ear and the other in front of your chest. Slowly step forward into a bow stance: one hand sweeps down past the front knee while the other pushes forward from the ear at chest height. Turn the waist with the hands, then shift your weight back smoothly and repeat. Keep repeating slowly and continuously. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Stand with knees soft, one hand near its ear and opposite forearm in front of chest.
Step forward into bow stance, one hand sweeping down past front knee, other palm extending ahead at chest height.
Ease weight onto back leg and gather hands, maintaining the same forward-facing orientation.

name: Repulse the monkey
instruction: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees soft, one hand forward and the other by your waist. Slowly step backward, landing on the toes first and then lowering the heel. As you step, one hand pushes forward while the other draws back by the waist, palms turning smoothly. Alternate legs and hands in a smooth flow, repeating continuously for the whole time.
phases: Stand with feet hip-width and slightly staggered, one palm forward and other by waist.
Step back onto rear toes, both hands passing through middle at different heights.
Set rear heel down and transfer weight, now other palm forward and first hand by waist.

name: White crane spreads its wings
instruction: Stand with your weight on the back leg and the front toes lightly touching the floor. As you inhale, raise one hand above your forehead, palm outward. As you exhale, press the other hand down softly beside your hip and hold the pose calmly. Move smoothly to the other side and keep repeating slowly and continuously. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Set weight over back leg with front toes touching lightly, arms relaxed in front.
Raise one hand above forehead, palm outward, opposite palm pressing down beside hip, back leg bearing weight.
Shift smoothly into the mirrored crane position, the other hand high and weight over the other leg.

name: Golden rooster stands on one leg
instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Slowly lift one knee to hip height or lower, raising the same-side hand so the elbow sits above the knee. Press the other palm gently down beside your hip and find your balance. Lower the leg and hands slowly, then keep repeating this smooth cycle for the whole time. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Stand upright on both feet, knees soft and hands low.
Balance with one knee lifted comfortably, matching elbow above that knee and opposite palm beside hip.
Return both feet and hands gently down, shoulders relaxed.

name: Grasp the bird's tail
instruction: Take a bow stance with one foot forward, weight on it and knees soft. Raise the front forearm in front of you. Shift your weight back and softly draw the hands toward you. Bring the palms together, shift forward, then push the palms smoothly ahead. Keep repeating this whole cycle smoothly for the whole time. When the app tells you to change sides, switch to the other side.
phases: Bow stance with weight forward and lead forearm rounded in front of chest.
Shift weight back and draw hands inward, keeping elbows soft.
Shift forward again and extend palms ahead in a controlled push, heels grounded.

name: Single whip
instruction: Take a wide stance with soft knees and your weight centered. Shift your weight and turn; extend one arm to the side and bring the fingertips together into a hook. Circle the other hand past your face. Shift the weight the opposite way and push that palm out softly, settling the hips. Return smoothly and keep repeating the movement for the whole time.
phases: Wide stance, knees soft, turn to one side with that arm extended and fingertips joined in a loose hook.
Keep hook arm extended, circle the other open palm across front of face as weight passes centre.
Settle onto the opposite leg with the open palm extended sideways and hook hand remaining out.

name: Tai chi closing
instruction: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees soft. Cross your hands in front of your chest. Slowly open the arms out to the sides. Lower the palms smoothly to the hips while softly straightening the knees. Keep repeating this slow movement for the whole time, then breathe calmly.
phases: Stand shoulder-width with soft knees and hands crossed in front of chest.
Open both arms gently out to sides, elbows relaxed.
Lower palms beside hips while knees straighten softly.

name: Tai chi weight-shift walk
instruction: Stand tall with soft knees and your hands resting on your hips. Place the heel softly in front of you. Roll the foot down and shift your weight fully onto it. Only then lift the back foot and take the next step. Keep walking very slowly for the whole time, looking ahead.
phases: Stand tall with hands at hips; place one heel lightly ahead, toes lifted, weight still behind.
Roll the front foot flat and shift weight over it, rear heel releasing.
Lift the rear foot and swing it forward for the next controlled heel placement.

name: Shadow boxing
instruction: Take a fighting stance with soft knees and fists by your face. Stay on the balls of your feet and move lightly. Throw light straight punches, alternating right and left. Add hooks, turning the torso with each one. Return the hands to the guard after every punch and keep going for the whole time.
phases: Stand alone in an open exercise space, feet staggered, knees soft and hands raised comfortably.
Extend one arm into the empty space, torso turning a little, other hand held up.
Show the opposite arm reaching across a curved path in the air, with feet grounded and no contact or target.

name: Lateral bounds
instruction: Stand on one leg with the other foot slightly off the floor. Push off and bound sideways onto the other foot. Land softly on the ball of the foot with the knee bent and over the toes. Hold the landing for a second, then bound back. Swing your arms for balance. Count both directions together, then finish the set in the app.
phases: Balance on the right foot, right knee softly bent, free leg trailing behind, arms balancing.
Bound sideways with both feet just off floor, arms counterbalancing.
Land and stabilize on the bent left leg, right leg trailing behind.

name: Tuck jumps
instruction: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms in front. Dip slightly and jump straight up. Pull your knees toward your chest in the air. Land softly on the balls of the feet with bent knees. Reset briefly and repeat. When you are done, finish the set in the app.
phases: Feet shoulder-width with knees bent in a little preparatory dip, arms in front.
Jump vertically and draw knees upward in the air, leaving clear space below feet.
Land softly on both feet with hips and knees flexed, body balanced.

name: Front kicks
instruction: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up by your face. Lift one knee forward. Extend the lower leg and kick forward with the ball of the foot. Pull the leg back and put it down under control. Do all reps on one side, then the other, then finish the set in the app.
phases: Stand balanced in a staggered stance facing clear, empty floor, hands up.
Lift one bent knee in front, keeping the standing knee soft and torso tall.
Gently extend the lifted lower leg forward at low height into clear space, supporting foot planted.

name: Single-leg hops
instruction: Stand on one leg with the knee slightly bent. Hop forward a small distance. Land softly on the same leg with the knee bent and over the toes. Stabilise, then hop again. Do all hops on one leg, then the other, then finish the set in the app.
phases: Balance on one foot with supporting knee softly flexed and other foot lifted.
Hop forward a short distance on the same side, both feet briefly airborne.
Land on the same foot, knee bent and aligned over toes, free leg hovering.

name: Side lunge
instruction: Stand tall with your feet together and chest up. Take a wide step to the side. Bend that knee and sit your hips back while the other leg stays straight. Keep both feet pointing forward and the heel of the bent leg down. Push back to the start. Do all reps on one side, then the other, then finish the set in the app.
phases: Stand hip-width, hands comfortably in front and toes forward.
Step sideways, shift hips back, bend the stepping knee over toes, keep the other leg straight and both feet planted.

name: Skipping without a rope
instruction: Stand tall with your elbows close and hands at hip height. Hop lightly on the balls of your feet. Circle your wrists as if turning a rope. Keep your knees soft and land quietly. Keep the rhythm until the app tells you to stop.
phases: Stand tall with hands relaxed at hip height as though holding an imaginary rope, knees soft.
Hop a small distance off floor with both feet, wrists slightly rotated, elbows close and shoulders low.

name: McGill curl-up
instruction: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg straight. Slide both hands, palms down, under your lower back to keep its natural curve. Lift your head and shoulders a few centimetres as one block, neck neutral. Hold for 2 to 3 seconds, then lower slowly. Halfway through the set, swap which knee is bent.
phases: Supine with one leg straight, other knee bent and foot flat, both hands under lumbar curve and head resting.
Raise head and shoulders together a few centimetres, neck neutral, hand and leg position unchanged.

name: Bird dog
instruction: Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back neutral. Slowly reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body. Hold for 2 seconds without dropping or twisting the pelvis. Return to the start and repeat. Do all reps on one side, then switch to the other pair. When both sides are done, tap Done.
phases: On hands and knees with hands beneath shoulders, knees beneath hips and back neutral.
Reach one arm straight forward and opposite leg straight back to trunk height, pelvis level and spine long.

name: Side plank on knees
instruction: Lie on your side, forearm under the shoulder, knees bent with feet behind you. Lift your hips until your body is straight from head to knees. Put your free hand on your hip and hold. Breathe calmly and keep your shoulder away from your ear. When the app says “Change sides”, turn over to the other side.
phases: Hold side plank on a forearm and lower knee. Both knees bent, hips elevated into a straight shoulder–hip–knee line, upper hand on hip.

name: Wall angels
instruction: Stand with your head, upper back and pelvis against a wall, feet a step forward. Draw your ribs down. Bend your arms into a W, elbows and backs of the hands toward the wall. Slowly slide your arms up toward a Y. Slide back down to the W just as slowly. Keep contact with the wall only as far as is comfortable.
phases: Stand against a wall with head, upper back and pelvis supported; elbows bent in W and ribs down.
Slide arms up toward a Y with backs of hands near wall, keeping ribcage quiet.

name: Open book on your side
instruction: Lie on your side, hips and knees bent 90°, a cushion under your head. Stretch both arms straight forward, palms together. Keep your knees together and slowly open the top arm in an arc to the other side, following your hand with your eyes. Rest the arm where it is comfortable and breathe calmly. When the app says “Change sides”, turn over to the other side.
phases: Side-lying open book in its held open position: bent knees stacked together, cushion under head, top arm extended behind as chest and gaze turn toward it.

name: Sphinx
instruction: Lie on your stomach, elbows under your shoulders, forearms on the floor. Let your chest rise gently while your pelvis and legs stay relaxed on the floor. Move your shoulders away from your ears and keep your neck long. Breathe calmly and hold the position.
phases: Prone with elbows beneath shoulders and forearms flat, chest gently lifted, pelvis and legs resting, gaze slightly ahead on floor.

name: Belly breathing lying down
instruction: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Put one hand on your chest and one on your belly. Breathe in slowly through your nose so your belly rises under your hand and your chest stays quiet. Breathe out longer through your mouth as your belly lowers. Repeat at your own calm pace.
phases: Lie on back with bent knees and feet flat, one hand on chest and the other on belly, head supported and shoulders relaxed.

name: Back and lat stretch at a chair
instruction: Kneel facing a stable chair or sofa. Place your forearms or hands on the seat. Move your hips back toward your heels and let your chest sink between your arms, back long. Feel the stretch along the sides of your back and armpits. Breathe calmly.
phases: Kneel facing a stable chair, forearms supported on seat, hips back toward heels and chest gently lowered between extended arms.

name: Short foot
instruction: Sit or stand with bare feet flat on the floor. Without curling the toes, draw the ball of the foot toward the heel. The arch lifts and the foot gets slightly shorter. Keep the toes long and relaxed on the floor. Hold the position, then release.
phases: Sit upright, bare heel and ball of foot firmly grounded. Hold the gently shortened foot with arch domed, toes long on the floor, ankle aligned. Frame low enough to show the arch.

name: Towel scrunches
instruction: Sit on a chair with a small towel flat on the floor under one bare foot. Keep the heel down and grab the towel with the toes. Pull the towel toward you bit by bit. Spread the toes and grab again. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other foot.
phases: Sit on stable chair, heel planted and toes spread over a small flat towel.
With heel still planted, toes grip the cloth, bunching the towel toward the foot.

name: Toe lifts and spreads
instruction: Sit with bare feet flat on the floor. Lift only the big toes while the other toes stay down, then lower them. Lift the four small toes while the big toes stay down, then lower them. Spread all toes wide. That is one rep. Move slowly, then tap Done.
phases: Sit with feet bare and heels down. Lift only the big toes, other toes resting.
Lower big toes and lift the four smaller toes on each foot, heels unchanged.
Spread all toes wide on the floor without curling them.

name: Tibialis raises at a wall
instruction: Lean your back against a wall with heels about a foot length in front of it. Keep the legs straight but the knees not locked. Lift the toes and the front of the feet as high as you can. Pause for a second at the top. Lower the feet slowly to the floor.
phases: Lean upright against wall, feet a little forward, heels and forefeet grounded.
Lift both forefeet and toes off floor while both heels and back stay in place.

name: Walking on toes
instruction: Stand tall and rise high onto the balls of your feet. Walk on the spot or around the room with small steps. Keep the heels up and the body tall. Let your arms hang relaxed. Stay up on your toes until the exercise ends.
phases: Walk upright on both forefeet with heels raised, one foot taking a small step ahead.
Advance the other foot on its forefoot, heels still lifted, torso tall.

name: Walking on heels
instruction: Stand tall and shift your weight onto your heels. Lift the toes and the front of the feet. Walk on the spot or around the room with small steps. Keep the knees soft and the body upright. Let your arms hang relaxed.
phases: Walk upright on heels, forefeet lifted, left foot a short step ahead.
Right foot steps ahead on its heel with both sets of toes lifted, knees soft.

name: Sole stretch
instruction: Sit and cross one ankle over the other knee. Hold the toes of that foot with your hand. Gently pull the toes back toward the shin until you feel a stretch under the arch. The other hand can lightly rub the sole. When the app says “Change sides”, switch feet.
phases: Sit with ankle crossed over opposite knee; hand gently draws toes back toward shin while other hand steadies foot, arch visible.

name: Heel-to-toe rocks
instruction: Stand tall near a wall, feet hip-width apart. Slowly roll forward and rise onto the balls of your feet. Then roll back onto your heels, lifting the toes. One forward and back is one rep. Move smoothly, then tap Done.
phases: Stand tall near a wall, both heels lifted together, weight on forefeet.
Rock back onto both heels, forefeet and toes raised, knees soft.

name: Prone streamline hold
instruction: Lie on your stomach with arms overhead, one hand on top of the other. Keep your upper arms by your ears and your legs long and together. Lift your arms, head and chest slightly off the floor. Look down and reach long through your fingers and toes. Hold until the app signals the end.
phases: Lie prone, long legs together and toes reaching back. Reach arms overhead, hands overlapped, head and arms just clear of floor, neck long, gaze down.

name: Prone breaststroke arms
instruction: Lie on your stomach, arms forward, chest slightly lifted. Look down and keep your neck long. Sweep your arms out and back toward your hips, squeezing the shoulder blades. Bring your hands under your chest and stretch them forward again. Repeat slowly and smoothly.
phases: Lie prone, chest slightly raised, neck long and arms extended forward.
Sweep both arms outward and back toward hips, chest remaining low.
Recover the hands beneath chest with elbows bending before reaching forward again.

name: Standing front crawl arms
instruction: Stand tall with your knees soft. Make big alternating arm circles forward, like front crawl. Let each hand pass close to your ear as your torso turns slightly with each stroke. Breathe steadily and keep an easy pace. Continue until the app signals the end.
phases: Stand with soft knees, right arm reaching overhead near the ear, left arm beside hip, torso slightly turned.
Arms pass in opposite parts of a front-crawl circle, one reaching forward and the other recovering backward.
Left arm now reaches overhead by ear and right hand passes the hip, torso turning gently the other way.

name: Kneeling ankle stretch
instruction: Kneel on a soft surface with the tops of your feet flat on the floor. Place your hands on the floor beside your knees. Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel a stretch along the front of your ankles. Take weight off with your hands, or put a cushion between heels and buttocks, if needed. Hold until the app signals the end.
phases: Kneel on padded mat with tops of feet down and hands on floor beside knees; hips lowered gently toward heels, weight partly supported on hands.

name: Hanging knee raises
instruction: Check that the bar is secure, then hang from it with an overhand grip. Engage your shoulders slightly instead of hanging loosely. Bring your knees up toward your chest without swinging. Pause for a moment at the top. Lower your legs slowly and repeat.
phases: Hang still from secure overhead bar, hands overhand, shoulders engaged and legs down.
Raise both bent knees toward chest without swinging, shoulders still engaged.

name: Resisted finger extensions
instruction: Hold one hand in front of you with the fingers slightly curled. Cup the other hand's fingers over the fingernails. Slowly open the fingers against the light resistance. Close them again just as slowly. Do all reps on one hand, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Hold one hand in front with fingers curled slightly and fingertips of the other hand cupped lightly over nails.
Open the working fingers against that contact, opposite hand providing light resistance.

name: Towel squeeze
instruction: Roll a towel up tightly. Hold it in both hands in front of your body, elbows bent. Squeeze and twist hard, as if wringing out water. Let your forearms do the work and keep your shoulders relaxed. Keep going until the app signals the end, and keep breathing.
phases: Stand with elbows bent beside the body, shoulders relaxed. Hold a rolled towel horizontally under visible wringing tension between the two hands, wrists comfortably aligned.

name: Bear plank hold
instruction: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders, knees under hips and toes tucked. Brace your stomach. Lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor. Keep your back flat and your hips level with your back. Hold until the app signals the end.
phases: On hands and toes with knees bent under hips and hovering just above floor, arms vertical below shoulders, back flat and hips level.

name: Sprawl
instruction: Stand in an athletic stance: feet wider than shoulders, knees bent. Place your hands on the floor in front of you. Send both legs back and lower the hips toward the floor, legs wide, chest up. Bring the feet back under you and stand into the stance. Do all reps, then tap Done.
phases: Low athletic stance, feet wider than shoulders, hips back and hands in front.
Crouch and plant both palms on floor in front of feet.
Legs extended wide behind, hips low, chest lifted on hands, neck long.

name: Shot step
instruction: Get into a wrestling stance, knees bent, hands forward. Lower the hips by bending the knees, not the back. Take a long step with the lead leg and bring the back knee close to the floor. Keep the chest up and hands forward; then step back to the stance. Do all reps leading with one leg, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand alone with feet staggered, knees soft and hands in front.
Lower hips and step forward with one foot; back knee hovers just above floor, chest lifted, no contact with another person.

name: Neck isometrics: front and back
instruction: Sit or stand tall with the neck neutral. Put a palm on your forehead and press your head gently into it at half effort; the head does not move. Halfway through, move your hands to the back of your head. Press your head gently back into your hands without moving it. Breathe steadily until the end.
phases: Sit tall with neck neutral and shoulders low. Hold one palm on the forehead and gently press the head forward into the stationary hand; the head stays level and still.
Maintain the same upright posture. Rest both hands on the back of the head with elbows comfortably apart, pressing the head backward into the hands without moving the neck.

name: Neck isometrics: sideways
instruction: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down. Place a palm on the side of your head, above the ear. Press your head gently into the hand at half effort without tilting it. Breathe steadily and keep your shoulders down. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other hand and side.
phases: Seated tall, palm against side of head above ear. Head remains centred, gently pressing into hand while both shoulders stay level.

name: Cossack squat
instruction: Stand with your feet wide and toes slightly out. Shift your weight to one side and sit down into that knee, keeping the heel of the bent leg down. Keep the other leg straight with the toes up and the chest up. Push back up to the middle. Do all reps to one side, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand with feet wide, toes slightly outward, trunk upright.
Sit the hips toward one heel, bending that knee; other leg stays straight with toes lifted, bent-side heel grounded.

name: Curtsy lunge
instruction: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart. Step one leg back and diagonally behind the other. Bend both knees into a lunge, front knee over the toes, hips square. Push back up to standing. Do all reps on one side, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand tall, feet hip-width and hips facing forward.
Cross one foot diagonally behind the other, lower into a small curtsy lunge, front heel grounded and front knee tracking toes.

name: Low-stance shuffles
instruction: Get into a low athletic stance: knees bent, chest up, weight on the balls of your feet. Shuffle a few quick steps sideways in one direction. Shuffle back the other way. Don't cross your feet and keep your hips low. Keep shuffling until the time is up.
phases: Stay low, facing ahead with knees bent, slightly wider than hip-width and weight toward forefeet.
Shuffle right with the right foot leading, no crossing, hips at the same height.
Shuffle left with left foot leading, no crossing, facing ahead.

name: Russian twists
instruction: Sit with your knees bent and heels on the floor. Lean back slightly with a long, straight back. Hold your hands together in front of your chest. Turn your shoulders to one side, then to the other; each side counts as one rep. Do all reps, then tap Done.
phases: Sit with knees bent, heels planted, torso leaning slightly back and hands together in front; turn shoulders gently left.
Turn shoulders and joined hands to the right, preserving the same pelvis and foot position.

name: Split step
instruction: Stand in a ready stance with your knees slightly bent. Make a small hop on the spot. Land softly on the balls of both feet, slightly wider than the hips, knees bent. Right away, take one quick step out to the side or forward and come back. Alternate directions and repeat.
phases: Start in a ready stance, knees soft, then rise just clear of floor in a small hop.
Land on both forefeet in a slightly wide stance, knees bent and hands ready.
Take one short step sideways from that landing, maintaining balance.

name: Forward lunge with push back
instruction: Stand tall. Take a long step forward into a lunge, front knee over the toes. Reach the same-side hand forward as if to a ball. Push off the front foot and return to standing. Do all reps on one leg, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand tall with both feet under hips and hands comfortably at sides.
Step one foot far forward, lower into a lunge and reach the same-side hand forward, front knee over toes.

name: Step-ups
instruction: Stand in front of a stable step 20–30 cm high. Put the whole foot of one leg on it. Push through that heel and step up until you stand tall. Step down slowly. Do all reps on one leg, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Face a stable low step with one whole foot on its top, the other foot on floor.
Press through the top foot and stand tall on the step, bringing the trailing foot up.

name: Lateral step-downs
instruction: Stand side-on on a low stable step on one leg, the other foot hanging off the side. Slowly bend the standing knee, hips back. Lightly touch the floor with the free heel. Straighten the standing leg and rise back up. Do all reps on one leg, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand sideways on low stable step on one leg, other foot hanging just off side, pelvis level.
Bend supporting knee, move hips back and touch free heel lightly to floor beside step.

name: Golf-stance torso turns
instruction: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Hinge slightly forward from the hips with a long back, arms crossed over your chest. Turn your shoulders one way as in a backswing, then the other way. Keep your hips fairly quiet. Do all the turns to one side, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Soft-kneed stance, slight hip hinge, back long and arms crossed over chest, shoulders turned gently to one side.
Pass through centre without straightening hips or moving feet.
Rotate shoulders to the other side with hips relatively quiet and feet planted.

name: Single-leg stand with torso turns
instruction: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, the other foot slightly lifted. Bring your hands together in front of your chest. Keeping your balance, slowly turn your shoulders to one side and back. Then turn to the other side. Hold a wall if needed. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other leg.
phases: Balance on one softly bent leg, hands together in front of chest, shoulders turned a little left.
Hold the same balance as shoulders pass through centre.
Turn shoulders right with hands following while pelvis stays facing forward.

name: Seated glute stretch on a chair
instruction: Sit tall near the front of a stable chair. Place one ankle on the opposite knee. Keeping your back long, hinge forward from the hips. Stop when you feel a stretch in the buttock and hold. When the app says “Change sides”, switch legs.
phases: Sit near front of stable chair with one ankle crossed over opposite knee, spine long and torso gently hinged forward at hips.

name: Bent-over reverse fly, no weights
instruction: Hinge forward from the hips with soft knees and a long flat back, arms hanging down, thumbs pointing out. Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top. Lower your arms slowly. Repeat at a steady pace.
phases: Hinge at hips, knees soft, back flat, empty hands hanging beneath shoulders with thumbs turned out.
Lift the arms sideways near shoulder height, shoulder blades drawing together, body still hinged.

name: Streamline on your tummy
instruction: Lie on your tummy on a mat, legs long and together. Stretch your arms up beside your ears, one hand on top of the other. Reach your fingers forward and your toes back, like an arrow. Lift your arms and head just a little, eyes looking down. Hold and keep breathing calmly.
phases: Lie prone, long legs together and toes reaching back. Reach arms overhead, hands overlapped, head and arms just clear of floor, neck long, gaze down.

name: Front crawl arms
instruction: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your tummy gently in. Swing one arm forward and up in a big circle, like front crawl. Let the hand pass by your ear and come down. Now do the same with the other arm, one after the other. Move smoothly and breathe calmly.
phases: Stand with soft knees, right arm reaching overhead near the ear, left arm beside hip, torso slightly turned.
Arms pass in opposite parts of a front-crawl circle, one reaching forward and the other recovering backward.
Left arm now reaches overhead by ear and right hand passes the hip, torso turning gently the other way.

name: Flipper kicks on your tummy
instruction: Lie on your tummy with your forehead on your hands and legs long. Point your toes like flippers. Make small quick kicks up and down with straight legs. Keep your knees almost straight and your hips on the floor. Kick steadily and breathe calmly.
phases: Lie prone, forehead on stacked hands, hips on mat and legs long. Right foot slightly above left.
Lift left foot slightly as right lowers, knees near straight and hips resting.

name: Boat on your tummy
instruction: Lie on your tummy with your arms stretched forward and legs long. Lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor. Look down and keep your neck long. Keep your legs straight like the bottom of a boat. Hold your boat and breathe calmly.
phases: Lie prone, arms stretched forward, chest and long legs hovering a small distance off mat, neck long and eyes down.

name: Boat on your back
instruction: Lie on your back, bend your knees toward your chest and reach your arms forward. Press your lower back into the floor. Lift your head and shoulders just a little. Hold your small boat. Stronger kids can straighten the legs a bit. Breathe calmly and hold.
phases: Supine tuck hold, knees drawn up and bent, lower back against mat, shoulders and head slightly lifted, arms reaching forward.

name: Frog arms on your tummy
instruction: Lie on your tummy with your arms stretched forward and your chest lifted a little. Sweep your arms out to the sides, like a frog swimming. Bring your hands under your chest. Stretch your arms forward again. Move smoothly, do all the reps in a row, then tap Done.
phases: Prone with chest slightly lifted and neck long, both arms reaching forward.
Sweep arms out to sides as elbows soften.
Bring hands beneath chest ready to reach forward, keeping shoulders away from ears.

name: Swallow balance
instruction: Stand near a wall on one leg with your arms out like wings. Tip your body forward and lift your other leg behind you. Make your body and the raised leg one long line. Hold your swallow. If you wobble, touch the wall with a hand. When the app says “Change sides”, switch to the other leg.
phases: Balance on one foot, arms stretched sideways, torso tipped forward and free leg extended backward as one long line, gaze slightly ahead on floor.

name: Tuck sit hold
instruction: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your hands on the floor beside your hips. Lean back a little with a straight back. Lift your feet off the floor, knees still bent. Hold the tuck and look forward. Breathe calmly and don't rock.
phases: Sit with palms planted beside hips, torso leaning slightly back with a straight spine, knees bent and both feet held off the floor.

name: Rocking in a tuck
instruction: Sit on a mat and pull your knees to your chest. Hold your shins with your hands and tuck your chin. Rock back on your round back to your shoulder blades. Roll forward and sit up again without letting go of your knees. Keep rocking smoothly, like a ball.
phases: Sit on mat in a tight tuck, hands holding shins, chin tucked.
Rock backward on the rounded back to shoulder blades, keeping knees tucked, head and neck clear of loading.

name: Side roll from sitting
instruction: Sit on a mat with legs forward and chin tucked. Bring one arm across your chest. Roll gently onto that side and slap the mat with your arm. Come back to sitting. Do all rolls to one side, then the other side, then tap Done.
phases: Sit on mat with legs in front, chin tucked and one arm across the chest.
Gently roll onto that side and extend the arm along the mat, head clear of the floor, torso resting on the side.

name: Bear crawl
instruction: Get on your hands and feet, knees bent and just above the floor. Keep your back flat like a table. Step forward with your right hand and left foot. Now step with your left hand and right foot. Crawl a few steps forward and back.
phases: Bear-crawl position, knees bent hovering, right hand and left foot moving forward together.
Shift to left hand and right foot advancing, back level and knees just off the mat.

name: Crab walk
instruction: Sit on the floor and put your palms behind your hips, fingers pointing forward. Bend your knees and put your feet flat. Lift your hips so your body is like a table. Walk on your hands and feet forward, then back, like a crab. Step slowly and keep your hips high.
phases: Face-up crab position with hips raised, palms on floor behind hips and knees bent. Advance right hand and left foot.
Maintain elevated hips and advance left hand and right foot.

name: Straight punch from stance
instruction: Stand in a stance with one foot forward, knees soft, fists by your chin. Punch one arm straight forward at the air, palm down. Bring the fist back to your chin quickly. Keep the other hand by your face the whole time. Do all punches with one arm, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand alone with staggered feet, soft knees and hands up, facing empty space.
One arm extended forward into empty air for the solo exercise; other hand stays near the chest, feet grounded.

name: Front kick
instruction: Stand in a stance with your hands up by your face. Lift your knee. Push your foot forward at the air, low, with the ball of the foot. Pull the leg back and put the foot down softly. Do all kicks with one leg, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Stand balanced in a staggered stance facing clear, empty floor, hands up.
Lift one bent knee in front, keeping the standing knee soft and torso tall.
Gently extend the lifted lower leg forward at low height into clear space, supporting foot planted.

name: Side leg swing with support
instruction: Stand side-on to a wall and rest one hand on it. Keep your body upright and your toes pointing forward. Swing the outside leg smoothly out to the side. Lower it back down just as smoothly. Do all swings with one leg, then turn around, do the other leg, then tap Done.
phases: Stand sideways to the wall with one hand on it and outside leg near the supporting leg.
Move outside leg sideways a short distance, toes forward, standing knee soft and torso upright.

name: Horse stance
instruction: Stand with your feet wide, toes forward or slightly out. Bend your knees as if sitting on a horse. Keep your back straight and your fists at your belt. Point your knees the same way as your toes. Hold the stance until the cue.
phases: Hold a wide stance, knees bent in the direction of toes, back upright, hands close to waist.

name: Clap and step to the beat
instruction: Stand tall with your feet together. Step to the side and bring your feet together. Then step the other way. Clap your hands on every second step. Then change the pattern: clap twice, step-together. Keep the rhythm even, like music.
phases: Stand tall with feet together and hands apart at chest height.
Step one foot sideways, arms relaxed apart.
Bring feet together and clap hands lightly at chest height.

name: Skips on the spot
instruction: Stand tall and bend your elbows. Hop on one foot and lift the other knee up. Switch feet right away, like skipping. Swing your arms in time with your legs. Land softly on the balls of your feet.
phases: Skip on right foot as left knee lifts and right arm swings forward.
Switch to left-foot support, right knee lifted and left arm forward.

name: Plié
instruction: Stand tall with your heels close and toes turned out comfortably. Round your arms in front, as if hugging a big ball. Bend your knees out over your toes, keeping your back straight. Straighten up and stand tall. Repeat calmly, with no rush.
phases: Stand tall, heels near each other, toes turned out comfortably, arms curved in front.
Bend knees outward above toes into a gentle plié, heels grounded, torso vertical and arms curved.

name: Skater jumps
instruction: Stand on one foot with the knee slightly bent. Jump sideways to the other foot, like a speed skater. Land softly on a bent knee and freeze for one second. Swing the free leg behind you and use your arms for balance. Count each landing.
phases: Balance on the right foot, right knee softly bent, free leg trailing behind, arms balancing.
Bound sideways with both feet just off floor, arms counterbalancing.
Land and stabilize on the bent left leg, right leg trailing behind.

name: Skater's stance hold
instruction: Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Bend your knees, as if sitting on an invisible chair. Lean your chest forward with a flat back, like a board. Put your hands behind your back, like a skater gliding. Hold the pose until the signal.
phases: Hold skater stance with feet hip-width, knees bent, hips back, trunk leaning forward with a long back and hands behind hips.

name: Jump up, land softly
instruction: Stand shoulder-width apart and bend your knees a little. Swing your arms up and jump straight up. Land quietly on the balls of your feet with bent knees pointing over your toes. Freeze for one second, like a cat. Straighten up and repeat.
phases: Prepare with feet shoulder-width, knees bent and hips back, arms down.
Jump straight up, feet clearly off the floor and arms reaching upward.
Land on both feet, knees flexed in line with toes and hips back to absorb impact.

name: Wall push-ups
instruction: Stand an arm’s length from a wall. Put your hands on the wall at chest height. Bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the wall with a straight body. Push away and straighten your arms. Repeat calmly, with no rush.
phases: Stand at arm's length from wall, hands planted at chest height, elbows straight, feet steady.
Bend elbows and bring chest toward wall, body straight from head through heels.

name: Windmill arms
instruction: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart. Lift your straight arms out to the sides. Make big circles forward with both arms, like windmill blades. After a few circles, change direction: circle backward. Move calmly and smoothly.
phases: Stand erect, both straight arms forward at shoulder height as they circle, feet shoulder-width.
Both arms sweep upward overhead in the same large circle, hands relaxed.
Arms sweep down past the sides to continue the circle, feet and trunk steady.

name: Tiptoe walk
instruction: Stand tall with your feet together. Rise high on your tiptoes, like a giraffe. Take small, calm steps. Keep your heels high the whole time.
phases: Walk upright on both forefeet with heels raised, one foot taking a small step ahead.
Advance the other foot on its forefoot, heels still lifted, torso tall.

name: Heel walk
instruction: Stand tall with your arms by your sides. Lift your toes up off the floor. Walk on your heels, like a penguin. Keep your back straight and your steps small.
phases: Walk upright on heels, forefeet lifted, left foot a short step ahead.
Right foot steps ahead on its heel with both sets of toes lifted, knees soft.

name: Teddy bear walk on outer edges
instruction: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Roll your feet onto their outer edges and curl your toes a little. Walk slowly, like a little bear. Keep your knees soft and your steps small.
phases: Walk with knees soft and feet tipped mildly toward their outer edges, one foot just ahead.
Switch the leading foot in another short, controlled step on the outer edges.

name: Scrunch a towel with your toes
instruction: Sit on a chair with one bare foot on the floor. Put a small towel or cloth under that foot. Grab the towel with your toes and pull it in bit by bit. Keep your heel down and your leg still. When the app says “Change sides”, switch feet.
phases: Sit on stable chair, heel planted and toes spread over a small flat towel.
With heel still planted, toes grip the cloth, bunching the towel toward the foot.

name: Foot caterpillar
instruction: Sit on a chair with your bare feet flat on the floor. Curl the toes of one foot and pull the heel toward them. Stretch the toes forward, so the foot crawls like a caterpillar. Crawl forward, then crawl back the same way. Do all reps with one foot, then the other, then tap Done.
phases: Sit on chair with one bare foot flat and toes lengthened forward.
Curl the toes against the floor, drawing the heel a little forward toward them.
Extend toes forward again from the new heel position, heel staying grounded.

name: Draw with your toes
instruction: Sit on a chair and lift one foot a little. Draw big circles in the air with your big toe. Then draw letters, moving only your ankle. Keep your knee and shoulders calm. When the app says “Change sides”, switch feet.
phases: Sit with one foot slightly lifted and knee still. Viewed obliquely, the toes trace the upper part of a circle.
From the same seat and camera, toes point out toward the side of the circle as the ankle turns.
Toes pass through the lower part of the circle, knee held still; use the same ankle articulation to trace letters.

name: Toe piano
instruction: Sit on a chair with your bare feet flat on the floor. Lift only your big toes, then put them down. Press your big toes down and lift the other toes. Switch back and forth, like playing the piano. Move slowly and evenly.
phases: Seated, bare feet planted. Raise just the big toes; four smaller toes on each foot remain down.
Keep the big toes down while lifting the four smaller toes; both heels remain grounded.

name: Up on toes, roll to heels
instruction: Stand tall next to a wall with your feet together. Rise high up on your tiptoes. Slowly roll back onto your heels and lift your toes. Rock like a rocking chair, smoothly and without rushing. Touch the wall with your hand if you need support.
phases: Stand tall near a wall, both heels lifted together, weight on forefeet.
Rock back onto both heels, forefeet and toes raised, knees soft.
